DEPARTMENT O F AGRICULTURE
Commodity Credit Corporation
7 CFR Part 1410
BINS 0560-AC66 and 0560-AC93
Amendments to the Conservation  
Reserve Program Regulations  
Regarding Small Wetlands and Other  
Statutory Requirements
A GEN CY: Commodity Credit Corporation, 
USDA.
A C T IO N : Final rule.
SU M M A R Y : This action covers four 
general areas. First, the final rule 
adopts, with changes, the proposed rule 
published on June 25,1992, at 57 FR 
28468 concerning the eligibility of small 
farmed wetlands to be enrolled in the 
Conservation Reserve Program (CRP). 
This allows producers greater flexibility 
in both enrolling and achieving 
enhanced environmental benefits under 
CRP. Second, the regulations are 
amended to incorporate certain 
nondiscretionary changes regarding 
limited grazing and easement 
requirements of the CRP, as required by 
the Food, Agriculture, Conservation, 
and Trade Act Amendments of 1991 
(the 1991 Act) (Pub. L. 102-237) and 
legislation entitled “To Amend the Food 
Security Act of 1985 To. Remove Certain 
Easement Requirements Under the 
Conservation Reserve Program and for 
Other Purposes“ (the 1992 Act) (Pub. L. 
102-324). Third, the regulations are 
amended to be consistent with the 
Wetlands Reserve Program (WRP) 
provisions relative to CRP participants 
offering eligible wetlands for enrollment 
into the WRP. The WRP final rule was 
published on June 4,1992 (57 FR 
23908). Fourth, the regulations are 
amended to ensure clarity and accuracy. 
EFFECTIVE DATE: January 13,1993.
FO R  FU RTH ER IN FO R M A T IO N  CO N TA CT:
James R. McMullen, Director, 
Conservation and Environmental 
Protection Division, ASCS, USDA, P.O. 
Box 2415, Washington, DC 20013-2415; 
phone 202-720-6221.
SUPPLEM ENTARY IN FO R M A T IO N : This final 
rule has been reviewed under USDA 
procedures established in accordance 
with Executive Order 12291 and 
provisions of Departmental Regulation 
1512-1 and has been classified as 
“nonmajor.“ It has been determined that 
these provisions will not result in: (1)
An annual effect on the national 
economy of $100 million or more; (2) a 
major increase in costs or prices for 
consumers, individual industries, State 
or local agencies, or geographic regions; 
or (3) significant adverse effects on 
competition, employment, investment, 
productivity, innovation, or on the 
ability of United States-based 
enterprises to compete with foreign- 
based enterprises in domestic or export 
markets.
It has been determined by an 
environmental evaluation that this 
action will not adversely affect the 
environmental, historical, social, or 
economic resources of the Nation. 
Therefore, it has been determined that 
these actions will not require an 
Environmental Assessment nor an 
Environmental Impact Statement.
This program/activity is not subject to 
the provisions of Executive Order 12372 
which requires intergovernmental 
consultation with State and local 
officials. See notice related to 7 CFR 
part 3015, subpart V, published at 48 FR 
29115 (June 24,1983).
This final rule has been reviewed in 
accordance with Executive Order 12778. 
The provisions of this final rule are not 
retroactive and do not preempt State 
laws. Before any judicial action may be 
taken with respect to the provisions of 
this final rule, administrative remedies 
at 7 CFR part 780 must be exhausted.
The title and number of the Federal 
Domestic Assistance Program, as found 
in the Catalog of Federal Domestic 
Assistance, to which this rule applies 
are Conservation Reserve Program— 
10.069.
The information and collection 
requirements of this final rule at 7 CFR 
part 1410 have been submitted to the 
Office of Management and Budget for 
review and approval in accordance with 
the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1980. A 
response from OMB regarding the
information collection approval is 
forthcoming.
The public reporting burden for the 
information collections required by this 
final rule is estimated to be 7 minutes 
per response, including the time for 
reviewing instructions, searching 
existing data sources, gathering and 
maintaining the data needed, and 
completing and reviewing the collection 
of information.
Current Regulations
The current regulations in 7 CFR part 
1410, published as a final rule on April 
19,1991 (56 FR 15980), implemented 
the Environmental Conservation 
Acreage Reserve Program, which 
consists of CRP and WRP.
The intent of CRP is to permit the 
Commodity Credit Corporation (CCC) to 
enter into contracts with owners and 
operators of highly erodible and other 
environmentally sensitive cropland to 
assist such owners and operators in 
conserving and improving the Nation’s 
soil and water resources. By entering 
into a contract, the owner or operator 
agrees to implement a conservation plan 
approved by the local Conservation 
District for converting highly erodible 
cropland normally devoted to the 
production of an agricultural 
commodity to a less intensive use. CCC 
provides (1) technical assistance by way 
of a conservation plan, (2) financial 
assistance for the costs of establishing 
the conservation practices required by 
the conservation plan, and (3) annual 
land rental payments to compensate the 
owner or operator for taking the 
cropland out of production.
The current regulations address the 
following terms and conditions of the 
CRP for enrollment during 1991 through 
1995: (1) eligibility of land; (2) duration 
of contracts; (3) obligations of 
participants and CCC; (4) eligible 
practices; (5) levels of cost-share for 
establishing practices; (6) provisions for 
annual rental payments; (7) handling of 
violations; and (8) other program 
matters.
With respect to land eligibility,
§ 1410.103 provides that the Secretary of 
Agriculture (Secretary) may consider 
certain lands to be eligible for CRP if a 
useful life easement is created for the 
practice. Further, § 1410.103 prohibits 
the enrollment of farmed wetlands 
otherwise eligible for CRP.
Section 1410.108 permits, if approved 
by CCC, land subject to an existing CRP

contract to be enrolled into WRP, 
provided that (1) the application for 
transfer into WRP is made during the 
first or second available signup for 
intention period under the WRP for the 
State, and (2) all funds and benefits paid 
under the CRP contract were refunded 
with interest.
Section 1410.110 generally prohibits 
any harvesting, or grazing, or other 
commercial use of the forage on land 
subject to a CRP contract, except that 
the Secretary could permit fall and 
winter grazing of grass waterways where 
the grazing is incidental to the gleaning 
of crop residue on the fields in which 
the grass waterways are located for an 
applicable reduction in rental payment.
Statutory Changes
Title XII of the Food, Agriculture, 
Conservation, and Trade Act of 1990 
(the*199G Act) (Pub. L. 101-624) enacted 
on November 28,1990, amended the 
Food Security Act of 1985 (the 1985 
Act) (Pub. L. 99-198) with respect to 
CRP. Section 1232(a)(7) of the 1990 Act 
was amended on December 13,1991, by 
the 1991 Act to specify that the 
Secretary may permit incidental grazing 
of CRP (1) during the 7-month period in 
which grazing of conserving use acreage 
is allowed in a State under the price 
support programs, or (2) after the 
producer harvests the grain crop of the 
surrounding field. In either case, the 
CRP rental payment must be reduced 
commensurate with the limited 
economic value of such incidental 
grazing. J J
The 1992 Act amended section 
1231(b)(4)(C) and section 1235A(a)(2) of 
the 1985 Act, as amended, to remove 
certain easement requirements under 
CRP.
Other Changes
This rule also (1) amends the 
regulations in 7 CFR 1410.108 to reflect 
consistency with the final rule for WRP 
published at 7 CFR part 703 on June 4, 
1992, (2) corrects a typographical error, 
(3) includes minor editorial changes for 
clarity, and (4) due to further review of 
statutory authority, removes the 
provision that payments made under 
part 1410 are subject to the regulations 
under 7 CFR part 796—Denial of 
Program Eligibility for Controlled 
Substance Violation.
CRP will continue to be implemented 
by CCC through the Agricultural 
Stabilization and Conservation Service 
(ASCS) using ASCS’s State and county 
offices.
Discussion of Comments
CCC received five comments ,  
concerning the proposed rule published
on June 25,1992, at 57 FR 28468.
Entities responding included a State 
farm organization, a national farm 
organization, two national wildlife 
organizations, and a member of 
Congress. The discussion of comments 
that follows is organized in the same 
sequence as the final rule.
Thus, all the changes made by this 
final rule are based on a combination of 
the public comments to the proposed 
rule, recent legislative changes and 
other statutory requirements, CCC’s 
experience in administering CRP since 
inception, and the need for clear, 
current, and consistent regulations.
S ection  1410.103 E lig ible L an d
Three comments supported the 
inclusion of small farmed wetlands as 
land eligible to be enrolled in CRP, 
stating that the proposal would not 
interfere with the enrollment of eligible 
land into WRP, and this expansion of 
cropland eligibility would further 
enhance the improvement of soil and, 
water resources. Two additional 
comments supported the concept and 
recommended that the approved plan 
provide for the continued protection of 
the eligible small wetland areas and that 
these areas be contained in fields that 
are otherwise eligible for CRP. Although 
this was the intent of the proposed rule, 
the final rule has been clarified to 
ensure that the small farmed wetlands 
to be enrolled are (1) limited to small 
areas included in otherwise eligible 
fields, and (2) guaranteed enduring 
protection under the approved 
conservation plan.
List of Subjects in 7 CFR Part 1410
Administrative practices and 
procedures, Conservation plan. 
Contracts, Easements, Environmental 
indicators, Natural resources, and 
Technical assistance.

Reporting Authorities for Internal

AGENCY: Farmers Home Administration, 
USDA.
ACTION: Final rule. _______
SU M M A R Y : The Farmers Home 
Administration (FmHA) amends its 
regulations regarding designated 
reporting authorities for internal 
processing of appeals cases. This action 
is necessary due to Agency provisions 
which require certain Agency officials 
to make decisions for cases in the 
appeal process. The intended effect is to 
ensure correct processing of appeals. 
EFFECTIVE DATE: January 1 3 ,1 9 9 3 .
FO R  FU RTH ER IN FO R M A T IO N  CO N TA CT: 
Jennifer Barton, Community Facilities 
Division, Farmers Home 
Administration, room 6 314, South 
Agriculture Building, Washington, DC 
20250, telephone (202) 7 2 0 -1 5 0 4 .
SUPPLEM ENTARY IN FO R M A T IO N : This 
action has been reviewed under USDA 
procedures established in Departmental 
Regulation 1512-1, which implements 
Executive Order 12291. Since this 
action has no impact on FmHA 
borrowers or other members of the 
public, it has been determined to be 
exempt from those requirements 
because it involves only internal Agency 
management. It is the policy of this 
Department to publish, for comment, 
rules relating to public property, loans, 
grants, benefits, or contracts, 
notwithstanding the exemption in 5 
U.S.C. 553 with respect to such rules. 
This action, however, is not published 
for proposed rule making since it 
involves only internal Agency 
management and publication for 
comment is unnecessary. Community 
and Business Programs have been 
assigned to the Rural Development 
Adm inistration (RDA), and RDA is now 
administering this program. RDA is 
utilizing FmHA regulations which 
makes it necessary to establish the 
organizational structure of RDA's 
reporting authorities for its Regional 
Office operations. Specifically, Exhibit 
D of subpart B of part 1900 is amended 
to include RDA personnel as decision 
makers for RDA cases involved in 
appeals.
Environmental Impact Statement
This document has been reviewed in 
accordance with 7 CFR part 1940, 
subpart G, “Environmental Program.” 
FmHA has determined that this action 
does not constitute a major Federal 
action significantly affecting the quality 
of the human environment, and, in 
accordance with the National 
Environmental Policy Act of 1969, 
Public Law 91-190, an Environmental 
Impact Statement is not required.

Sec. 10. Notice. For those persons whose property and interests in property 
are blocked pursuant to this order who might have a constitutional presence 
in the United States, I find that because of the ability to transfer funds 
or other assets instantaneously, prior notice to such persons of measures 
to be taken pursuant to this order would render those measures ineffectual. 
I therefore determine that for these measures to be effective in addressing 
the national emergency declared in Executive Order 12957, there need be 
no prior notice of an action taken pursuant to subsection 3(a)(ii), 3(b)(i)(D), 
or 3(c)(i) of this order.

In order to take additional steps with respect to the proliferation
of weapons of mass destruction and means of delivering them and the
national emergency described and declared in Executive Order 12938 of
November 14, 1994, as amended by Executive Order 13094 of July 30,
1998, section 3 of Executive Order 12938, as amended, is amended to
add a new subsection (e) to read as follows:
‘‘(e) the Secretary of Commerce shall impose and enforce such restrictions
on the importation of chemicals into the United States as may be necessary
to carry out the requirements of the Convention on the Prohibition of
the Development, Production, Stockpiling and Use of Chemical Weapons
and on Their Destruction.’’
Sec. 9.
```

46589
Federal Register 
Vol. 54, No. 212
Presidential Documents
Friday, November 3, 1989
Title 3— Executive Order 12695
The President Delegation of Debt Relief Authority
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and laws of the 
United States of America, including the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961, as 
amended, and section 572 of the Foreign Operations, Export Financing, and 
Related Programs Appropriations Act, 1989 (Public Law 100-461, 102 Stab 
2268), and in order to delegate certain relief authority to the Administrator of 
the Agency for International Development, it is hereby ordered as follows:
Section 1 . Delegation o f Presidential Authority under Section 572 of the  
Foreign Operations, Export Financing, and Related Programs Appropriations 
Act, 1989. Section l-102(a) of Executive Order No. 12163, as amended, is 
further amended by (A) deleting “and” at the end of subsection (9), (B) 
deleting the period and inserting and” at the end of subsection (10), and (C) 
adding a subsection (11) as follows:
“(11) section 572 of the Foreign Operations, Export Financing, and Related 
Programs Appropriations Act, 1989 (Public Law 100-461), to be exercised by 
the Administrator of the Agency for International Development within IDCA, 
with the concurrence of the Development Coordination Committee, as estab­
lished by section 640B of the Act and as provided for herein.”.
Sec. 2. Effective Date. This order shall take effect immediately.
[FR Doc. 89-26182 
Filed 11-2-89; 11:12 am] 
Billing code 3195-Ol-M
THE WHITE HOUSE, ( y  
November 1, 1989.

chronology does not decide legal effect.","provision_text":"Sec. 6. Executive Order 13231 of October 16, 2001, as amended, is further \namended by striking section 3, except subsection (c) thereof, and inserting \nimmediately preceding subsection (c), the following: \n‘‘Sec. 3. The National Infrastructure Advisory Council. The National Infra-\nstructure Advisory Council (NIAC), established on October 16, 2001, shall \nprovide the President, through the Secretary of Homeland Security, with \nadvice on the security and resilience of the critical infrastructure sectors \nand their functional systems, physical assets, and cyber networks. \n‘‘(a) Membership. The NIAC shall be composed of not more than 30 \nmembers appointed by the President, taking appropriate account of the \nbenefits of having members: \n‘‘(i) from the private sector, including individuals with experience in \nbanking and finance, transportation, energy, water, communications, health \ncare services, food and agriculture, government facilities, emergency serv-\nices organizations, institutions of higher education, environmental and \nclimate resilience, and State, local, and tribal governments; \nVerDate Mar<15>2010 17:21 Oct 03, 2013 Jkt 232001 PO 00000 Frm 00002 Fmt 4790 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\04OCE0.SGM 04OCE0EMCDONALD on DSK67QTVN1PROD with MISCELLANEOUS\n=== PDF page 3 of 4 ===\n61819 Federal Register / Vol. 78, No. 193 / Friday, October 4, 2013 / Presidential Documents \n‘‘(ii) with senior executive leadership responsibilities for the availability \nand reliability, including security and resilience, of critical infrastructure \nsectors; \n‘‘(iii) with expertise relevant to the functions of the NIAC; and \n‘‘(iv) with experience equivalent to that of a chief executive of an organiza-\ntion. \n‘‘Unless otherwise determined by the President, no full-time officer or \nemployee of the executive branch shall be appointed to serve as a member \nof the NIAC. The President shall designate from among the members of \nthe NIAC a Chair and a Vice Chair, who shall perform the functions of \nthe Chair if the Chair is absent or disabled, or in the instance of a vacancy \nin the Chair. \n‘‘(b) Functions of the NIAC. The NIAC shall meet periodically to: \n‘‘(i) enhance the partnership of the public and private sectors in securing \nand enhancing the security and resilience of critical infrastructure and \ntheir supporting functional systems, physical assets, and cyber networks, \nand provide reports on this issue to the President, through the Secretary \nof Homeland Security, as appropriate; \n‘‘(ii) propose and develop ways to encourage private industry to perform \nperiodic risk assessments and implement risk-reduction programs; \n‘‘(iii) monitor the development and operations of critical infrastructure \nsector coordinating councils and their information-sharing mechanisms \nand provide recommendations to the President, through the Secretary \nof Homeland Security, on how these organizations can best foster improved \ncooperation among the sectors, the Department of Homeland Security, \nand other Federal Government entities; \n‘‘(iv) report to the President through the Secretary of Homeland Security, \nwho shall ensure appropriate coordination with the Assistant to the Presi-\ndent for Homeland Security and Counterterrorism, the Assistant to the \nPresident for Economic Policy, and the Assistant to the President for \nNational Security Affairs under the terms of this order; and \n‘‘(v) advise sector-specific agencies with critical infrastructure responsibil-\nities to include issues pertaining to sector and government coordinating \ncouncils and their information sharing mechanisms. \n‘‘In implementing this order, the NIAC shall not advise or otherwise \nact on matters pertaining to National Security and Emergency Preparedness \n(NS/EP) Communications and, with respect to any matters to which the \nNIAC is authorized by this order to provide advice or otherwise act on \nthat may depend on or affect NS/EP Communications, shall coordinate with \nthe National Security and Telecommunications Advisory Committee estab-\nlished by Executive Order 12382 of September 13, 1982, as amended.’’.","sections_touched":["section 3"],"signing_date":"2013-09-30","source":{"filing_date":null,"location_confidence":"high","location_verified":false,"page_or_item":"78 FR 61817, PDF pages 1-4","requires_page_check":false,"sha256":"a10494b1ea9767f3c5d574fcc8b6acc25153eb7854492e0f4d3e740363ad4f91","signing_date":"2013-09-30","text_path":"jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_13652.txt","text_sha256":"515fe385b0129b1dd411dc9791d7904cdfa1d614bc5462e7b9d78491f6170958","url":"https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2013-10-04/pdf/2013-24388.pdf"},"verb":"amend"},{"actor_id":"EO:14048","char_end":7325,"char_start":6843,"confidence":"medium","how_named":"direct","id":"CHAIN:EO:12382#4","notes":"Change wording lead; chronology does not decide legal effect.","provision_text":"Executive Order 11926 \nof July 19, 1976, as amended by Executive Order 13286 of February 28, \n2003, is further amended as follows: \n(a) in section 1, by striking ‘‘and Coast Guard’’ and inserting in lieu \nthereof ‘‘Coast Guard, commissioned corps of the National Oceanic and \nAtmospheric Administration, and commissioned corps of the Public Health \nService’’; \n(b) in section 1, by inserting ‘‘, or who have been assigned to perform \nduties predominantly for the Vice President for a period of at least one \nyear subsequent to January 20, 2001, in the implementation of Public Law \n93–346, as amended, or in military units and support facilities to which \nsection 1 of Executive Order 12793 of March 20, 1992, as amended, refers’’ \nimmediately preceding the period; \n(c) in section 2, by striking ‘‘Military Assistant to the Vice President’’ \nand inserting in lieu thereof ‘‘Vice President’s designee (with the concurrence \nof the Director of the White House Military Office in the case of personnel \nin military units or support facilities to which section 1 of Executive Order \n12793, as amended, refers)’’; \n(d) in section 2, by inserting ‘‘and, in the case of members of the commis-\nsioned corps of the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration or \nthe commissioned corps of the Public Health Service so assigned, by the \nSecretary of Commerce or the Secretary of Health and Human Services, \nrespectively’’ immediately preceding the period; \n(e) in section 5, by adding at the end of the section ‘‘No award shall \nbe made to an individual under this Order based on a period of service \nwith respect to which, in whole or in part, the individual was awarded \nthe Presidential Service Badge.’’; \n(f) in section 6, by striking ‘‘and Coast Guard,’’ and inserting in lieu \nthereof ‘‘Coast Guard, commissioned corps of the National Oceanic and \nAtmospheric Administration, and commissioned corps of the Public Health \nService,’’; \n(g) in section 6, by inserting ‘‘, or who has been assigned to perform \nduties predominantly for the Vice President, in the implementation of Public \nLaw 93–346, as amended, or in military units and support facilities to \nwhich section 1 of Executive Order 12793, as amended, refers,’’ after ‘‘Office \nof the Vice President’’; \n(h) in section 6, by inserting ‘‘, unless otherwise directed by the Director \nof the White House Military Office in the case of personnel in military \nunits or support facilities to which section 1 of Executive Order 12793, \nas amended, refers,’’ after ‘‘is authorized’’; \n(i) in section 6, by inserting ‘‘or her’’ after ‘‘his’’; and \n(j) in section 6, by striking ‘‘first day of duty in the Office of the Vice \nPresident’’ and inserting in lieu thereof ‘‘first day of such duty’’.","sections_touched":["section 1","section 1","section 1","section 2","section 1","section 2","section 5","section 6","section 6","section 1","section 6","section 1","section 6","section 6"],"signing_date":"2005-03-10","source":{"filing_date":null,"location_confidence":"high","location_verified":false,"page_or_item":"70 FR 12579, PDF pages 1-2","requires_page_check":false,"sha256":"4a783e7a5b00b9fd4ee8db2b8c13b5627b0df63f71ff06a8a52d610085491c4f","signing_date":"2005-03-10","text_path":"jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_13373.txt","text_sha256":"b93d23e0bb50c539234a7ebb7febee5bd63e9a584274c71fd2d7a498bc163fe8","url":"https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2005-03-14/pdf/05-5097.pdf"},"verb":"amend"},{"actor_id":"EO:14131","char_end":1426,"char_start":1012,"confidence":"medium","how_named":"direct","id":"CHAIN:EO:12793#3","notes":"Change wording lead; - **ACT:EO:12938>EO:13094**; S94dfc549a0719c7f210a402f; {"actor_id":"EO:13094","char_end":4728,"char_start":3947,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":2451,"char_start":1609,"text":"Except\nto the extent provided in section 203(b) of the International Emergency\nEconomic Powers Act (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)), where applicable, if the Secretary\nof State determines that a foreign person, on or after November 16, 1990,\nthe effective date of Executive Order 12735, the predecessor order to\nExecutive Order 12938, has materially contributed or attempted to contrib-\nute materially to the efforts of any foreign country, project, or entity\nof proliferation concern to use, acquire, design, develop, produce, or stock-\npile weapons of mass destruction or missiles capable of delivering such\nweapons, the measures set forth in subsections (b), (c), and (d) of this\nsection shall be imposed on that foreign person to the extent determined\nby the Secretary of State in consultation with the implementing agency\nand other relevant agencies."},{"char_end":4728,"char_start":3947,"text":"Departments and agencies of the United States Govern-\nment, acting in consultation with the Secretary of State, may, by license,\nregulation, order, directive, exception, or otherwise, provide for:\n(i) Procurement contracts necessary to meet U.S. operational military\nrequirements or requirements under defense production agreements; in-\ntelligence requirements; sole source suppliers, spare parts, components,\nroutine servicing and maintenance of products for the United States\nGovernment; and medical and humanitarian items; and\n(ii) Performance pursuant to contracts in force on the effective date\nof this order under appropriate circumstances.’’\n(b) Section 6 of Executive Order 12938 of November 14, 1994, is amended\nby deleting ‘‘4(c)’’ and inserting ‘‘4(e)’’ in lieu thereof."},{"char_end":5177,"char_start":4766,"text":"Nothing in this order is intended to\naffect the continued effectiveness of any rules, regulations, orders, licenses,\nor other forms of administrative action issued, taken, or continued in effect\nheretofore or hereafter under the authority of IEEPA, AECA, the Nuclear\nNon-Proliferation Act of 1978, the Nuclear Proliferation Prevention Act of\n1994, the Atomic Energy Act, the Export Administration Act (50 U.S.C."},{"char_end":5698,"char_start":5683,"text":"Effective Date."},{"char_end":5780,"char_start":5699,"text":"(a) This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on July\n29, 1998."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12938>EO:13094","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; - **ACT:EO:12938>EO:13094@22df02f55a608fa2**; S5daaa4459af4683ca0c50fcb; {"actor_id":"EO:13094","char_end":42154,"char_start":36988,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":3696,"char_start":3156,"text":"Subpart C—General Definitions \n539.301 Designated foreign person. \n539.302 Effective date. \n539.303 Entity. \n539.304 Entity owned or controlled by a per-\nson listed in appendix I to this part. \n539.305 General license. \n539.306 Goods, technology, or services pro-\nduced or provided by a designated foreign \nperson. \n539.307 Importation into the United States. \n539.308 Information or informational mate-\nrials. \n539.309 License. \n539.310 Person. \n539.311 Specific license. \n539.312 United States. \n539.313 United States person; U.S. person."},{"char_end":7329,"char_start":6979,"text":"Except as otherwise authorized, the \nimportation into the United States, on \nor after the effective date, directly or \nindirectly, of any goods, technology, or \nservices produced or provided by a des-\nignated foreign person, other than in-\nformation or informational materials, \nis prohibited. \n§ 539.202 Prohibition on import-re-\nlated transactions."},{"char_end":7739,"char_start":7331,"text":"Except as otherwise authorized, no \nUnited States person may finance, act \nas broker for, transfer, transport, or \notherwise participate in the importa-\ntion into the United States on or after \nthe effective date of any goods, tech-\nnology, or services produced or pro-\nvided by a designated foreign person, \nother than information or informa-\ntional materials. \n§ 539.203 Evasions; attempts; conspir-\nacies."},{"char_end":7997,"char_start":7741,"text":"Any transaction by any United \nStates person or within the United \nStates on or after the effective date \nthat evades or avoids, has the purpose \nof evading or avoiding, or attempts to \nviolate any of the prohibitions set \nforth in this part is prohibited."},{"char_end":11803,"char_start":11331,"text":"The Department of \nState publishes in the FEDERAL REGISTER the \nnames of persons determined to be subject to \nimport measures pursuant to section 4(a) of \nE.O. 12938, as amended, and maintains a list \nof such persons accessible through the fol-\nlowing page on the Department of State’s \nwebsite: https://www.state.gov/key-topics-bu-\nreau-of-international-security-and-non-\nproliferation/nonproliferation-sanctions/. \n[86 FR 73106, Dec. 27, 2021] \n§ 539.302 Effective date."},{"char_end":12078,"char_start":11805,"text":"The term effective date means the \n‘‘effective date’’ specified in the rel-\nevant FEDERAL REGISTER notice issued \nby the Department of State identifying \na designated foreign person. \n[64 FR 8716, Feb. 23, 1999, as amended at 86 \nFR 73106, Dec. 27, 2021] \n§ 539.303 Entity."},{"char_end":36073,"char_start":35780,"text":"In the event no \nsettlement is reached, the 30–day pe-\nriod specified in paragraph (a) of this \nsection for written response to the \nprepenalty notice remains in effect un-\nless additional time is granted by the \nOffice of Foreign Assets Control. \n§ 539.704 Penalty imposition or with-\ndrawal."},{"char_end":41764,"char_start":40644,"text":"Subpart C—General Definitions \n542.300 Applicability of definitions. \n542.301 Blocked account; blocked property. \n542.302 Construction or engineering serv-\nices. \n542.303 Deceptive transaction \n542.304 Effective date. \n542.305 Entity. \n542.306 Financial, material, or technological \nsupport. \n542.307 Foreign person. \n542.308 Government of Syria. \n542.309 Information and communications \ntechnology. \n542.310 Information or informational mate-\nrials. \n542.311 Interest. \n542.312 Knowingly. \n542.313 Licenses; general and specific. \n542.314 Loans or other extensions of credit. \n542.315 New investment. \n542.316 OFAC. \n542.317 Person. \n542.318 Person subject to United States \nsanctions concerning Syria. \n542.319 Petroleum or petroleum products of \nSyrian origin. \n542.320 Sensitive technology. \n542.321 Property; property interest. \n542.322 Syria; Syrian. \n542.323 Transfer. \n542.324 United States. \n542.325 United States person; U.S. person. \n542.326 U.S. depository institution. \n542.327 U.S. financial institution. \n542.328 U.S. registered broker or dealer in \nsecurities. \n542.329 U.S. registered money transmitter."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12938>EO:13094@22df02f55a608fa2","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending asserted. Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date.","provision_label":"","reaches_target_via":"","savings_phrases":[],"scope":"partial","signing_date":"1998-07-28","target_id":"EO:12938","verb":"transfer"}
  Text: [T604443269fd4bfb974e676d5](#t604443269fd4bfb974e676d5); absolute characters 36988–42154
- **ACT:EO:12938>EO:13094@6479cd588c28bd2a**; S94dfc549a0719c7f210a402f; {"actor_id":"EO:13094","char_end":4728,"char_start":3947,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":2451,"char_start":1609,"text":"Except\nto the extent provided in section 203(b) of the International Emergency\nEconomic Powers Act (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)), where applicable, if the Secretary\nof State determines that a foreign person, on or after November 16, 1990,\nthe effective date of Executive Order 12735, the predecessor order to\nExecutive Order 12938, has materially contributed or attempted to contrib-\nute materially to the efforts of any foreign country, project, or entity\nof proliferation concern to use, acquire, design, develop, produce, or stock-\npile weapons of mass destruction or missiles capable of delivering such\nweapons, the measures set forth in subsections (b), (c), and (d) of this\nsection shall be imposed on that foreign person to the extent determined\nby the Secretary of State in consultation with the implementing agency\nand other relevant agencies."},{"char_end":4728,"char_start":3947,"text":"Departments and agencies of the United States Govern-\nment, acting in consultation with the Secretary of State, may, by license,\nregulation, order, directive, exception, or otherwise, provide for:\n(i) Procurement contracts necessary to meet U.S. operational military\nrequirements or requirements under defense production agreements; in-\ntelligence requirements; sole source suppliers, spare parts, components,\nroutine servicing and maintenance of products for the United States\nGovernment; and medical and humanitarian items; and\n(ii) Performance pursuant to contracts in force on the effective date\nof this order under appropriate circumstances.’’\n(b) Section 6 of Executive Order 12938 of November 14, 1994, is amended\nby deleting ‘‘4(c)’’ and inserting ‘‘4(e)’’ in lieu thereof."},{"char_end":5177,"char_start":4766,"text":"Nothing in this order is intended to\naffect the continued effectiveness of any rules, regulations, orders, licenses,\nor other forms of administrative action issued, taken, or continued in effect\nheretofore or hereafter under the authority of IEEPA, AECA, the Nuclear\nNon-Proliferation Act of 1978, the Nuclear Proliferation Prevention Act of\n1994, the Atomic Energy Act, the Export Administration Act (50 U.S.C."},{"char_end":5698,"char_start":5683,"text":"Effective Date."},{"char_end":5780,"char_start":5699,"text":"(a) This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on July\n29, 1998."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12938>EO:13094@6479cd588c28bd2a","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending asserted.   Text: [T6603f14a02d705a05b46811b](#t6603f14a02d705a05b46811b); absolute characters 3369–3754
- **ACT:EO:12938>EO:13206**; S6c14ad479e9a720fdccb76a5; {"actor_id":"EO:13206","char_end":2812,"char_start":1439,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":1676,"char_start":1447,"text":"The revocation of Executive Order 12924 shall not affect any violation\nof any rules, regulations, orders, licenses, or other forms of administrative\naction under that order that occurred during the period the order was\nin effect."},{"char_end":2179,"char_start":1677,"text":"All rules and regulations issued or continued in effect under\nthe authority of IEEPA and Executive Order 12924, including those codified\nat 15 C.F.R. 730–74 (2000), and all orders, regulations, licenses, and other\nforms of administrative action issued, taken, or continued in effect pursuant\nthereto, remain in full force and effect, as if issued, taken, or continued\nin effect pursuant to and as authorized by the Act or by other appropriate\nauthority until amended or revoked by the proper authority."},{"char_end":3190,"char_start":2821,"text":"All rules, regulations, orders, licenses, and other forms of administra-\ntive action issued, taken, or continued in effect pursuant to the authority\nof IEEPA and Executive Order 12924 relating to the administration of section\n38(e) of the Arms Export Control Act (22 U.S.C. 2778(e)) shall remain in\nfull force and effect until amended or revoked under proper authority."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12938>EO:13206","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending asserted. Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date.","provision_label":"Section 1.","reaches_target_via":"","savings_phrases":["The revocation of Executive Order 12924 shall not affect any violation\nof any rules, regulations, orders, licenses, or other forms of administrative\naction under that order that occurred during the period the order was\nin effect.","All rules and regulations issued or continued in effect under\nthe authority of IEEPA and Executive Order 12924, including those codified\nat 15 C.F.R. 730–74 (2000), and all orders, regulations, licenses, and other\nforms of administrative action issued, taken, or continued in effect pursuant\nthereto, remain in full force and effect, as if issued, taken, or continued\nin effect pursuant to and as authorized by the Act or by other appropriate\nauthority until amended or revoked by the proper authority.","All rules, regulations, orders, licenses, and other forms of administra-\ntive action issued, taken, or continued in effect pursuant to the authority\nof IEEPA and Executive Order 12924 relating to the administration of section\n38(e) of the Arms Export Control Act (22 U.S.C. 2778(e)) shall remain in\nfull force and effect until amended or revoked under proper authority."],"scope":"partial","signing_date":"2001-04-04","target_id":"EO:12938","verb":"amend"}

- **ACT:EO:12938>EO:13382**; S774d1451880047044a39252d; {"actor_id":"EO:13382","char_end":5745,"char_start":5644,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":3630,"char_start":1463,"text":"(a) Except to the extent provided in section 203(b)(1), (3), and \n(4) of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)(1), (3), and (4)), or in regulations, orders, \ndirectives, or licenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwith-\nstanding any contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior \nto the effective date of this order, all property and interests in property \nof the following persons, that are in the United States, that hereafter come \nwithin the United States, or that are or hereafter come within the possession \nor control of United States persons, are blocked and may not be transferred, \npaid, exported, withdrawn, or otherwise dealt in: \n(i) the persons listed in the Annex to this order; \n(ii) any foreign person determined by the Secretary of State, in consultation \nwith the Secretary of the Treasury, the Attorney General, and other relevant \nagencies, to have engaged, or attempted to engage, in activities or trans-\nactions that have materially contributed to, or pose a risk of materially \ncontributing to, the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction or their \nmeans of delivery (including missiles capable of delivering such weapons), \nincluding any efforts to manufacture, acquire, possess, develop, transport, \ntransfer or use such items, by any person or foreign country of proliferation \nconcern; \n(iii) any person determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation \nwith the Secretary of State, the Attorney General, and other relevant \nagencies, to have provided, or attempted to provide, financial, material, \ntechnological or other support for, or goods or services in support of, \nany activity or transaction described in paragraph (a)(ii) of this section, \nor any person whose property and interests in property are blocked pursu-\nant to this order; and \n(iv) any person determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation \nwith the Secretary of State, the Attorney General, and other relevant \nagencies, to be owned or controlled by, or acting or purporting to act \nfor or on behalf of, directly or indirectly, any person whose property \nand interests in property are blocked pursuant to this order."},{"char_end":6918,"char_start":5845,"text":"Except \nto the extent provided in section 203(b) of the International Emergency \nEconomic Powers Act (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)), where applicable, if the Secretary \nof State, in consultation with the Secretary of the Treasury, determines \nthat a foreign person, on or after November 16, 1990, the effective date \nof Executive Order 12735, the predecessor order to Executive Order 12938, \nhas engaged, or attempted to engage, in activities or transactions that have \nmaterially contributed to, or pose a risk of materially contributing to, the \nproliferation of weapons of mass destruction or their means of delivery \n(including missiles capable of delivering such weapons), including any efforts \nto manufacture, acquire, possess, develop, transport, transfer, or use such \nitems, by any person or foreign country of proliferation concern, the measures \nset forth in subsections (b), (c), and (d) of this section shall be imposed \non that foreign person to the extent determined by the Secretary of State, \nin consultation with the implementing agency and other relevant agencies."},{"char_end":7734,"char_start":7484,"text":"I therefore determine that for these measures to be effective in addressing \nthe national emergency declared in Executive Order 12938, as amended, \nthere need be no prior notice of a listing or determination made pursuant \nto section 1 of this order."},{"char_end":9479,"char_start":9397,"text":"(a) This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on \nJune 29, 2005."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12938>EO:13382","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending asserted. Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date. order, and notwithstanding any contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the effective date of this order, all property and interests in property of the following persons, that are in the United States, that hereafter come within the United States, or that are or hereafter come within the possession or control of United States persons, are blocked and may not be transferred, paid, exported, withdrawn, or otherwise dealt in:"},{"char_end":5879,"char_start":4820,"text":"Except to the extent provided in section 203(b) of the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)), where applicable, if the Secretary of State, in consultation with the Secretary of the Treasury, determines that a foreign person, on or after November 16, 1990, the effective date of Executive Order 12735, the predecessor order to Executive Order 12938, has engaged, or attempted to engage, in activities or transactions that have materially contributed to, or pose a risk of materially contributing to, the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction or their means of delivery (including missiles capable of delivering such weapons), including any efforts to manufacture, acquire, possess, develop, transport, transfer, or use such items, by any person or foreign country of proliferation concern, the measures set forth in subsections (b), (c), and (d) of this section shall be imposed on that foreign person to the extent determined by the Secretary of State, in consultation with the implementing agency and other relevant agencies."},{"char_end":6682,"char_start":6435,"text":"I therefore determine that for these measures to be effective in addressing the national emergency declared in Executive Order 12938, as amended, there need be no prior notice of a listing or determination made pursuant to section 1 of this order."},{"char_end":8135,"char_start":8099,"text":"(a) This order is effective at applicable, if the Secretary \nof State, in consultation with the Secretary of the Treasury, determines \nthat a foreign person, on or after November 16, 1990, the effective date \nof Executive Order 12735, the predecessor order to Executive Order 12938, \nhas engaged, or attempted to engage, in activities or transactions that have \nmaterially contributed to, or pose a risk of materially contributing to, the \nproliferation of weapons of mass destruction or their means of delivery \n(including missiles capable of delivering such weapons), including any efforts \nto manufacture, acquire, possess, develop, transport, transfer, or use such \nitems, by any person or foreign country of proliferation concern, the measures \nset forth in subsections (b), (c), and (d) of this section shall be imposed \non that foreign person to the extent determined by the Secretary of State, \nin consultation with the implementing agency and other relevant agencies."},{"char_end":7734,"char_start":7484,"text":"I therefore determine that for these measures to be effective in addressing \nthe national emergency declared in Executive Order 12938, as amended, \nthere need be no prior notice of a listing or determination made pursuant \nto section 1 of this order."},{"char_end":9479,"char_start":9397,"text":"(a) This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on \nJune 29, 2005."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12938>EO:13382@b779d3a4af8fc835","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending asserted. following are prohibited, except to the extent provided in\nregulations, orders, directives, or licenses that may be issued pursuant to\nthis order, and notwithstanding any contract entered into or any license\nor permit granted prior to the effective date of this order: (a) the importation\ninto the United States, or the financing of such importation, of any goods\nor services of Iranian origin, other than Iranian-origin publications and mate-\nrials imported for news publications or news broadcast dissemination;\n(b) except to the extent provided in section 203(b) of IEEPA (50 U.S.C.\n1702(b)), the exportation from the United States to Iran, the Government\nof Iran, or to any entity owned or controlled by the Government of Iran,\nor the financing of such exportation, of any goods, technology (including\ntechnical data or other information subject to the Export Administration\nRegulations, 15 CFR Parts 768–799 (1994) (the ‘‘EAR’’)), or services;\n(c) the reexportation to Iran, the Government of Iran, or to any entity\nowned or controlled by the Government of Iran, of any goods or technology\n(including technical data or other information) exported from the United\nStates, the exportation of which to Iran is subject to export license application\nrequirements under any United States regulations in effect immediately prior\nto the issuance of this order, unless, for goods, they have been (i) substantially\ntransformed outside the United States, or (ii) incorporated into another prod-\nuct outside the United States and constitute less than 10 percent by value\nof that product exported from a third country;\n(d) except to the extent provided in section 203(b) of IEEPA (50 U.S.C.\n1702(b)), any transaction, including purchase, sale, transportation, swap,\nfinancing, or brokering transactions, by a United States person relating to\ngoods or services of Iranian origin or owned or controlled by the Government\nof Iran;\n(e) any new investment by a United States person in Iran or in property\n(including entities) owned or controlled by the Government of Iran;\n(f) the approval or facilitation by a United States person of the entry\ninto or performance by an entity owned or controlled by a United States\nperson of a transaction or contract (i) prohibited as to United States persons\nby subsection (c), (d), or (e) above, or (ii) relating to the financing of activities\nprohibited as to United States persons by those subsections, or of a guaranty\nof another person’s performance of such transaction or contract; and\n(g) any transaction order."},{"char_end":7292,"char_start":6592,"text":"(a) This order is effective at 12:01 a.m., eastern daylight time, on\nMay 7, 1995, except that (i) section 1(b), (c), and (d) of this order Federal regulations in force imme-\ndiately prior to the date of this order (‘‘existing trade contracts’’), and (ii)\nletters of credit and other financing agreements with respect to existing\ntrade contracts may be performed pursuant to their terms with respect to\nunderlying trade transactions occurring prior to 12:01 a.m., eastern daylight\ntime, on June 6, 1995."}],"exceptions_text":["to the {"actor_id":"EO:13059","char_end":10034,"char_start":9388,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":2091,"char_start":1554,"text":"Except to the extent provided in section 3 of this order or\nin regulations, orders, directives, or licenses issued pursuant to this order,\nand notwithstanding any contract entered into or any license or permit\ngranted prior to the effective date of this order, the importation into the\nUnited States of any goods or services of Iranian origin or owned or controlled\nby the Government of Iran, other than information or informational materials\nwithin the meaning of section 203(b)(3) of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)(3)),\nis hereby prohibited."},{"char_end":5781,"char_start":2100,"text":"Except to the extent provided in section 3 of this order, in section\n203(b) of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)), or in regulations, orders, directives,\nor licenses issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding any contract\nentered into or any license or permit granted prior to the effective date\nof this order, the following are prohibited:\n(a) the exportation, reexportation, sale, or supply, directly or indirectly,\nfrom the United States, or by a United States person, wherever located,\nof any goods, technology, or services to Iran or the Government of Iran,\nincluding the exportation, reexportation, sale, or supply of any goods, tech-\nnology, or services to a person in a third country undertaken with knowledge\nor reason to know that:\n(i) such goods, technology, or services are intended specifically for supply,\ntransshipment, or reexportation, directly or indirectly, to Iran or the Govern-\nment of Iran; or\n(ii) such goods, technology, or services are intended specifically for use\nin the production of, for commingling with, or for incorporation into goods,\ntechnology, or services to be directly or indirectly supplied, transshipped,\nor reexported exclusively or predominantly to Iran or the Government of\nIran;\n(b) the reexportation from a third country, directly or indirectly, by a\nperson other than a United States person of any goods, technology, or\nservices that have been exported from the United States, if:\n(i) undertaken with knowledge or reason to know that the reexportation\nis intended specifically for Iran or the Government of Iran, and\n(ii) the exportation of such goods, technology, or services to Iran from\nthe United States was subject to export license application requirements\nunder any United States regulations in effect on May 6, 1995, or thereafter\n=== PDF page 2 of 3 ===\n44532 Federal Register / Vol. 62, No. 162 / Thursday, August 21, 1997 / Presidential Documents\nis made subject to such requirements imposed independently of the actions\ntaken pursuant to the national emergency declared in Executive Order 12957;\nprovided, however, that this prohibition shall not apply to those goods\nor that technology subject to export license application requirements if such\ngoods or technology have been:\n(A) substantially transformed into a foreign-made product outside the Unit-\ned States; or\n(B) incorporated into a foreign-made product outside the United States\nif the aggregate value of such controlled United States goods and technology\nconstitutes less than 10 percent of the total value of the foreign-made product\nto be exported from a third country;\n(c) any new investment by a United States person in Iran or in property,\nincluding entities, owned or controlled by the Government of Iran;\n(d) any transaction or dealing by a United States person, wherever located,\nincluding purchasing, selling, transporting, swapping, brokering, approving,\nfinancing, facilitating, or guaranteeing, in or related to:\n(i) goods or services of Iranian origin or owned or controlled by the\nGovernment of Iran; or\n(ii) goods, technology, or services for exportation, reexportation, sale, or\nsupply, directly or indirectly, to Iran or the Government of Iran;\n(e) any approval, financing, facilitation, or guarantee by a United States\nperson, wherever located, of a transaction by a foreign person where the\ntransaction by that foreign person would be prohibited by this order if\nperformed by a United States person or within the United States; and\n(f) any transaction by a United States person or within the United States\nthat evades or avoids, or has the purpose of evading or avoiding, or attempts\nto violate, any of the prohibitions set forth in this order."},{"char_end":6023,"char_start":5790,"text":"Specific licenses issued pursuant to Executive Orders 12613 (of\nOctober 29, 1987), 12957, or 12959 continue in effect in accordance with\ntheir terms except to the extent revoked, amended, or modified by the\nSecretary of the Treasury."},{"char_end":6290,"char_start":6024,"text":"General licenses, regulations, orders, and directives\nissued pursuant to those orders continue in effect in accordance with their\nterms except to the extent inconsistent with this order or to the extent\nrevoked, amended, or modified by the Secretary of the Treasury."},{"char_end":7812,"char_start":6299,"text":"For the purposes of this order:\n(a) the term ‘‘person’’ means an individual or entity;\n(b) the term ‘‘entity’’ means a partnership, association, trust, joint venture,\ncorporation, or other organization;\n(c) the term ‘‘United States person’’ means any United States citizen,\npermanent resident alien, entity organized under the laws of the United\nStates (including foreign branches), or any person in the United States;\n(d) the term ‘‘Iran’’ means the territory of Iran and any other territory\nor marine area, including the exclusive economic zone and continental\nshelf, over which the Government of Iran claims sovereignty, sovereign\nrights, or jurisdiction, provided that the Government of Iran exercises partial\nor total de facto control over the area or derives a benefit from economic\nactivity in the area pursuant to international arrangements;\n(e) the term ‘‘Government of Iran’’ includes the Government of Iran, any\npolitical subdivision, agency, or instrumentality thereof, and any person\nowned or controlled by, or acting for or on behalf of, the Government\nof Iran;\n(f) the term ‘‘new investment’’ means:\n(i) a commitment or contribution of funds or other assets; or\n(ii) a loan or other extension of credit, made after the effective date\nof Executive Order 12957 as to transactions prohibited by that order, or\notherwise made after the effective date of Executive Order 12959.\n=== PDF page 3 of 3 ===\n44533Federal Register / Vol. 62, No. 162 / Thursday, August 21, 1997 / Presidential Documents\nSec. 5."},{"char_end":9698,"char_start":9497,"text":"Executive Order 12613 and subsections\n(a), (b), (c), (d), and (f) of section 1 of Executive Order 12959 are hereby\nrevoked with respect to transactions occurring after the effective date of\nthis order."},{"char_end":10034,"char_start":9699,"text":"The revocation of those provisions shall not alter their applicabil-\nity to any transaction or violation occurring before the effective date of\nthis order, nor shall it affect the applicability of any rule, regulation, order,\nlicense, or other form of administrative action previously taken pursuant\nto Executive Orders 12613 or 12959."},{"char_end":10589,"char_start":10506,"text":"(a) This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on\nAugust 20, 1997."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12957>EO:13059","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending asserted. Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date.","provision_label":"Sec. 6.","reaches_target_via":"","savings_phrases":["Specific licenses issued pursuant to Executive Orders 12613 (of\nOctober 29, 1987), 12957, or 12959 continue in effect in accordance with\ntheir terms except to the extent revoked, amended, or modified by the\nSecretary of the Treasury.","General licenses, regulations, orders, and directives\nissued pursuant to those orders continue in effect in accordance with their\nterms except to the extent inconsistent with this order or to the extent\nrevoked, amended, or modified by the Secretary of the Treasury."],"scope":"partial","signing_date":"1997-08-19","target_id":"EO:12957","verb":"revoke"}

any transaction or violation occurring before the effective date of\nthis order, nor shall it affect the applicability of any rule, regulation, order,\nlicense, or other form of administrative action previously taken pursuant\nto Executive Orders 12613 or 12959."},{"char_end":10589,"char_start":10506,"text":"(a) This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on\nAugust 20, 1997."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12957>EO:13059@4625ed583e3d38e3","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending asserted. - **ACT:EO:12957>EO:13059@855ec7348a117b97**; S6c8568374928015ac4e595a3; {"actor_id":"EO:13059","char_end":10034,"char_start":9388,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":2091,"char_start":1554,"text":"Except to the extent provided in section 3 of this order or\nin regulations, orders, directives, or licenses issued pursuant to this order,\nand notwithstanding any contract entered into or any license or permit\ngranted prior to the effective date of this order, the importation into the\nUnited States of any goods or services of Iranian origin or owned or controlled\nby the Government of Iran, other than information or informational materials\nwithin the meaning of section 203(b)(3) of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)(3)),\nis hereby prohibited."},{"char_end":5781,"char_start":2100,"text":"Except to the extent provided in section 3 of this order, in section\n203(b) of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)), or in regulations, orders, directives,\nor licenses issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding any contract\nentered into or any license or permit granted prior to the effective date\nof this order, the following are prohibited:\n(a) the exportation, reexportation, sale, or supply, directly or indirectly,\nfrom the United States, or by a United States person, wherever located,\nof any goods, technology, or services to Iran or the Government of Iran,\nincluding the exportation, reexportation, sale, or supply of any goods, tech-\nnology, or services to a person in a third country undertaken with knowledge\nor reason to know that:\n(i) such goods, technology, or services are intended specifically for supply,\ntransshipment, or reexportation, directly or indirectly, to Iran or the Govern-\nment of Iran; or\n(ii) such goods, technology, or services are intended specifically for use\nin the production of, for commingling with, or for incorporation into goods,\ntechnology, or services to be directly or indirectly supplied, transshipped,\nor reexported exclusively or predominantly to Iran or the Government of\nIran;\n(b) the reexportation from a third country, directly or indirectly, by a\nperson other than a United States person of any goods, technology, or\nservices that have been exported from the United States, if:\n(i) undertaken with knowledge or reason to know that the reexportation\nis intended specifically for Iran or the Government of Iran, and\n(ii) the exportation of such goods, technology, or services to Iran from\nthe United States was subject to export license application requirements\nunder any United States regulations in effect on May 6, 1995, or thereafter\n=== PDF page 2 of 3 ===\n44532 Federal Register / Vol. 62, No. 162 / Thursday, August 21, 1997 / Presidential Documents\nis made subject to such requirements imposed independently of the actions\ntaken pursuant to the national emergency declared in Executive Order 12957;\nprovided, however, that this prohibition shall not apply to those goods\nor that technology subject to export license application requirements if such\ngoods or technology have been:\n(A) substantially transformed into a foreign-made product outside the Unit-\ned States; or\n(B) incorporated into a foreign-made product outside the United States\nif the aggregate value of such controlled United States goods and technology\nconstitutes less than 10 percent of the total value of the foreign-made product\nto be exported from a third country;\n(c) any new investment by a United States person in Iran or in property,\nincluding entities, owned or controlled by the Government of Iran;\n(d) any transaction or dealing by a United States person, wherever located,\nincluding purchasing, selling, transporting, swapping, brokering, approving,\nfinancing, facilitating, or guaranteeing, in or related to:\n(i) goods or services of Iranian origin or owned or controlled by the\nGovernment of Iran; or\n(ii) goods, technology, or services for exportation, reexportation, sale, or\nsupply, directly or indirectly, to Iran or the Government of Iran;\n(e) any approval, financing, facilitation, or guarantee by a United States\nperson, wherever located, of a transaction by a foreign person where the\ntransaction by that foreign person would be prohibited by this order if\nperformed by a United States person or within the United States; and\n(f) any transaction by a United States person or within the United States\nthat evades or avoids, or has the purpose of evading or avoiding, or attempts\nto violate, any of the prohibitions set forth in this order."},{"char_end":6023,"char_start":5790,"text":"Specific licenses issued pursuant to Executive Orders 12613 (of\nOctober 29, 1987), 12957, or 12959 continue in effect in accordance with\ntheir terms except to the extent revoked, amended, or modified by the\nSecretary of the Treasury."},{"char_end":6290,"char_start":6024,"text":"General licenses, regulations, orders, and directives\nissued pursuant to those orders continue in effect in accordance with their\nterms except to the extent inconsistent with this order or to the extent\nrevoked, amended, or modified by the Secretary of the Treasury."},{"char_end":7812,"char_start":6299,"text":"For the purposes of this order:\n(a) the term ‘‘person’’ means an individual or entity;\n(b) the term ‘‘entity’’ means a partnership, association, trust, joint venture,\ncorporation, or other organization;\n(c) the term ‘‘United States person’’ means any United States citizen,\npermanent resident alien, entity organized under the laws of the United\nStates (including foreign branches), or any person in the United States;\n(d) the term ‘‘Iran’’ means the territory of Iran and any other territory\nor marine area, including the exclusive economic zone and continental\nshelf, over which the Government of Iran claims sovereignty, sovereign\nrights, or jurisdiction, provided that the Government of Iran exercises partial\nor total de facto control over the area or derives a benefit from economic\nactivity in the area pursuant to international arrangements;\n(e) the term ‘‘Government of Iran’’ includes the Government of Iran, any\npolitical subdivision, agency, or instrumentality thereof, and any person\nowned or controlled by, or acting for or on behalf of, the Government\nof Iran;\n(f) the term ‘‘new investment’’ means:\n(i) a commitment or contribution of funds or other assets; or\n(ii) a loan or other extension of credit, made after the effective date\nof Executive Order 12957 as to transactions prohibited by that order, or\notherwise made after the effective date of Executive Order 12959.\n=== PDF page 3 of 3 ===\n44533Federal Register / Vol. 62, No. 162 / Thursday, August 21, 1997 / Presidential Documents\nSec. 5."},{"char_end":9698,"char_start":9497,"text":"Executive Order 12613 and subsections\n(a), (b), (c), (d), and (f) of section 1 of Executive Order 12959 are hereby\nrevoked with respect to transactions occurring after the effective date of\nthis order."},{"char_end":10034,"char_start":9699,"text":"The revocation of those provisions shall not alter their applicabil-\nity to any transaction or violation occurring before the effective date of\nthis order, nor shall it affect the applicability of any rule, regulation, order,\nlicense, or other form of administrative action previously taken pursuant\nto Executive Orders 12613 or 12959."},{"char_end":10589,"char_start":10506,"text":"(a) This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on\nAugust 20, 1997."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12957>EO:13059@855ec7348a117b97","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending asserted. Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date.","provision_label":"Sec. 6.","reaches_target_via":"","savings_phrases":["Specific licenses issued pursuant to Executive Orders 12613 (of\nOctober 29, 1987), 12957, or 12959 continue in effect in accordance with\ntheir terms except to the extent revoked, amended, or modified by the\nSecretary of the Treasury.","General licenses, regulations, orders, and directives\nissued pursuant to those orders continue in effect in accordance with their\nterms except to the extent inconsistent with this order or to the extent\nrevoked, amended, or modified by the Secretary of the Treasury."],"scope":"partial","signing_date":"1997-08-19","target_id":"EO:12957","verb":"revoke"}

  Text: [T3f71e51a03493ef95604b784](#t3f71e51a03493ef95604b784); absolute characters 6038–6652
- **ACT:EO:12957>EO:13590**; Sc52f39ba1ea7c170ca0f82e8; {"actor_id":"EO:13590","char_end":13167,"char_start":12545,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":3205,"char_start":1356,"text":"The Secretary of State, in consultation with the Secretary of \nthe Treasury, the Secretary of Commerce, and the United States Trade Rep-\nresentative, and with the President of the Export-Import Bank, the Chairman \nof the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, and other agencies \nand officials as appropriate, is hereby authorized to impose on a person \nany of the sanctions described in section 2 or 3 of this order upon determining \nthat the person: \n(a) knowingly, on or after the effective date of this order, sells, leases, \nor provides to Iran goods, services, technology, or support that has a fair \nmarket value of $1,000,000 or more or that, during a 12-month period, \nhas an aggregate fair market value of $5,000,000 or more, and that could \ndirectly and significantly contribute to the maintenance or enhancement \nof Iran’s ability to develop petroleum resources located in Iran; \n(b) knowingly, on or after the effective date of this order, sells, leases, \nor provides to Iran goods, services, technology, or support that has a fair \nmarket value of $250,000 or more or that, during a 12-month period, has \nan aggregate fair market value of $1,000,000 or more, and that could directly \nand significantly contribute to the maintenance or expansion of Iran’s domes-\ntic production of petrochemical products; \n(c) is a successor entity to a person referred to in subsection (a) or \n(b) of this section; \n(d) owns or controls a person referred to in subsection (a) or (b) of \nthis section, and had actual knowledge or should have known that the \nperson engaged in the activities referred to in that subsection; or \n(e) is owned or controlled by, or under common ownership or control \nwith, a person referred to in subsection (a) or (b) of this section, and \nknowingly participated in the activities referred to in that subsection."},{"char_end":5576,"char_start":5248,"text":"(e) The prohibitions in subsections (a)-(d) of this section apply except \nto the extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, \nor licenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":8888,"char_start":8565,"text":"(d) The prohibitions in subsection (a) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":13167,"char_start":12938,"text":"I therefore determine that for these measures to be \neffective in addressing the national emergency declared in Executive Order \n12957, there need be no prior notice of an action taken pursuant to section \n3(a)(iv) of this order."},{"char_end":14419,"char_start":14337,"text":"This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on \nNovember 21, 2011."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12957>EO:13590","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending asserted. Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date.","provision_label":"Sec. 5.","reaches_target_via":"","savings_phrases":[],"scope":"partial","signing_date":"2011-11-20","target_id":"EO:12957","verb":"transfer"}

- **ACT:EO:12957>EO:13622**; S4dd7a3811adb64c2f2424851; {"actor_id":"EO:13622","char_end":21316,"char_start":20357,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":4742,"char_start":4419,"text":"(e) The prohibitions in subsection (b) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":6332,"char_start":4752,"text":"(a) The Secretary of State, in consultation with the Secretary of \nthe Treasury, the Secretary of Commerce, and the United States Trade Rep-\nresentative, and with the President of the Export-Import Bank, the Chairman \nof the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, and other agencies \nand officials as appropriate, is hereby authorized to impose on a person \nany of the sanctions described in section 3 or 4 of this order upon determining \nthat the person: \n(i) knowingly, on or after the effective date of this order, engaged in \na significant transaction for the purchase or acquisition of petroleum or \npetroleum products from Iran; \n(ii) knowingly, on or after the effective date of this order, engaged in \na significant transaction for the purchase or acquisition of petrochemical \nproducts from Iran; \n(iii) is a successor entity to a person determined by the Secretary of \nState in accordance with this subsection to meet the criteria in subsection \n(a)(i) or (a)(ii) of this section; \n(iv) owns or controls a person determined by the Secretary of State in \naccordance with this subsection to meet the criteria in subsection (a)(i) \nor (a)(ii) of this section, and had knowledge that the person engaged \nin the activities referred to in that subsection; or \n(v) is owned or controlled by, or under common ownership or control \nwith, a person determined by the Secretary of State in accordance with \nthis subsection to meet the criteria in subsection (a)(i) or (a)(ii) of this \nsection, and knowingly participated in the activities referred to in that \nsubsection."},{"char_end":9382,"char_start":9054,"text":"(e) The prohibitions in subsections (a)–(d) of this section apply except \nto the extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, \nor licenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":11467,"char_start":11133,"text":"(b) The prohibitions in subsections (a)(i)–(a)(v) of this section apply except \nto the extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, \nor licenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":13094,"char_start":12771,"text":"(c) The prohibitions in subsection (b) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":13588,"char_start":13104,"text":"Subsection 1(a), section 2, and subsection 5(a) of this order shall \nnot apply with respect to any person for conducting or facilitating a trans-\naction involving a natural gas development and pipeline project initiated \nprior to the effective date of this order to bring gas from Azerbaijan to \nEurope and Turkey in furtherance of a production sharing agreement or \nlicense awarded by a sovereign government other than the Government \nof Iran before the effective date of this order."},{"char_end":21349,"char_start":20797,"text":"I therefore \ndetermine that for these measures to be effective in addressing the national \nVerDate Mar<15>2010 07:44 Aug 01, 2012 Jkt 226001 PO 2012 / Presidential Documents \nemergency declared in Executive Order 12957, there need be no prior notice \nof an action taken pursuant to subsection (a)(iv) of section 4 or subsection \n(b) of section 5 of this order."},{"char_end":22614,"char_start":22536,"text":"This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on July \n31, 2012."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12957>EO:13622","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending asserted.
