{"actor_id":"EO:13645","char_end":29884,"char_start":29253,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":2384,"char_start":1707,"text":"(a) The Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary \nof State, is hereby authorized to impose on a foreign financial institution \nthe sanctions described in subsection (b) of this section upon determining \nthat the foreign financial institution has, on or after the effective date of \nthis order: \n(i) knowingly conducted or facilitated any significant transaction related \nto the purchase or sale of Iranian rials or a derivative, swap, future, \nforward, or other similar contract whose value is based on the exchange \nrate of the Iranian rial; or \n(ii) maintained significant funds or accounts outside the territory of Iran \ndenominated in the Iranian rial."},{"char_end":3594,"char_start":3271,"text":"(c) The prohibitions in subsection (b) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":5926,"char_start":5603,"text":"(c) The prohibitions in subsection (b) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":6984,"char_start":5936,"text":"(a) The Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary \nof State, is hereby authorized to impose on a foreign financial institution \nthe sanctions described in subsection (b) of this section upon determining \nthat the foreign financial institution has knowingly conducted or facilitated \nany significant financial transaction: \n(i) on behalf of any Iranian person included on the SDN List (other \nthan an Iranian depository institution whose property and interests in \nproperty are blocked solely pursuant to Executive Order 13599) or any \nother person included on the SDN List whose property and interests \nin property are blocked pursuant to subsection 2(a)(i) of this order or \nExecutive Order 13599 (other than an Iranian depository institution whose \nproperty and interests in property are blocked solely pursuant to Executive \nOrder 13599); or \n(ii) on or after the effective date of this order, for the sale, supply, or \ntransfer to Iran of significant goods or services used in connection with \nthe automotive sector of Iran."},{"char_end":9669,"char_start":9346,"text":"(f) The prohibitions in subsection (b) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":11484,"char_start":10047,"text":"The Secretary of State, in consultation with the Secretary of the \nTreasury, the Secretary of Commerce, the Secretary of Homeland Security, \nand the United States Trade Representative, and with the President of the \nExport-Import Bank, the Chairman of the Board of Governors of the Federal \nReserve System, and other agencies and officials as appropriate, is hereby \nauthorized to impose on a person any of the sanctions described in section \n6 or 7 of this order upon determining that the person: \n(a) on or after the effective date of this order, knowingly engaged in \na significant transaction for the sale, supply, or transfer to Iran of significant \ngoods or services used in connection with the automotive sector of Iran; \n(b) is a successor entity to a person determined by the Secretary of State \nin accordance with this section to meet the criteria in subsection (a) of \nthis section; \n(c) owns or controls a person determined by the Secretary of State in \naccordance with this section to meet the criteria in subsection (a) of this \nsection, and had knowledge that the person engaged in the activities referred \nto in that subsection; or \n(d) is owned or controlled by, or under common ownership or control \nwith, a person determined by the Secretary of State in accordance with \nthis section to meet the criteria in subsection (a) of this section, and know-\ningly participated in the activities referred to in that subsection."},{"char_end":14499,"char_start":14171,"text":"(g) The prohibitions in subsections (a)–(f) of this section apply except \nto the extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, \nor licenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":17799,"char_start":17476,"text":"(b) The prohibitions in subsection (a) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":19605,"char_start":19282,"text":"(b) The prohibitions in subsection (a) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":29884,"char_start":29627,"text":"I therefore determine that for these measures to be effective in addressing \nthe national emergency declared in Executive Order 12957, there need be \nno prior notice of an action taken pursuant to subsection 1(b)(ii), 2(b), \n7(a)(iv), or 8(a) of this order."},{"char_end":30921,"char_start":30473,"text":"(c) Subsection (a)(i) of section 2 is amended by replacing ‘‘knowingly, \non or after the effective date of this order, engaged in a significant transaction \nfor the purchase or acquisition of petroleum or petroleum products from \nIran’’ with ‘‘knowingly, on or after the effective date of this order, engaged \nin a significant transaction for the purchase, acquisition, sale, transport, \nor marketing of petroleum or petroleum products from Iran’’."},{"char_end":31355,"char_start":30923,"text":"(d) Subsection (a)(ii) of section 2 is amended by replacing ‘‘knowingly, \non or after the effective date of this order, engaged in a significant transaction \nfor the purchase or acquisition of petrochemical products from Iran’’ with \n‘‘knowingly, on or after the effective date of this order, engaged in a signifi-\ncant transaction for the purchase, acquisition, sale, transport, or marketing \nof petrochemical products from Iran’’."},{"char_end":32574,"char_start":32497,"text":"This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on July \n1, 2013."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12957>EO:13645","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending asserted. Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date.","provision_label":"Sec. 14.","reaches_target_via":"","savings_phrases":["It includes but is not limited to depository institutions, \nbanks, savings banks, money service businesses, trust companies, securities \nbrokers and dealers, commodity futures and options brokers and dealers, \nforward contract and foreign exchange merchants, securities and commodities \nexchanges, clearing corporations, investment companies, employee benefit \nplans, dealers in precious metals, stones, or jewels, and holding companies, \naffiliates, or subsidiaries of any of the foregoing.","The term does not include \nthe international financial institutions identified in 22 U.S.C. 262r(c)(2), \nthe International Fund for Agricultural Development, the North American \nDevelopment Bank, or any other international financial institution so notified \nby the Secretary of the Treasury; \n(e) the term ‘‘Government of Iran’’ includes the Government of Iran, any \npolitical subdivision, agency, or instrumentality thereof, including the Central \nVerDate Mar<15>2010 19:51 Jun 04, 2013 Jkt 226001 PO 00000 Frm 00006 Fmt 4790 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\05JNE0.SGM 05JNE0mstockstill on DSK4VPTVN1PROD with PREDOCE0\n=== PDF page 7 of 9 ===\n33951 Federal Register / Vol. 78, No. 108 / Wednesday, June 5, 2013 / Presidential Documents \nBank of Iran, and any person owned or controlled by, or acting for or \non behalf of, the Government of Iran; \n(f) the term ‘‘Iran’’ means the Government of Iran and the territory of \nIran and any other territory or marine area, including the exclusive economic \nzone and continental shelf, over which the Government of Iran claims sov-\nereignty, sovereign rights, or jurisdiction, provided that the Government \nof Iran exercises partial or total de facto control over the area or derives \na benefit from economic activity in the area pursuant to international arrange-\nments; \n(g) the term ‘‘Iranian depository institution’’ means any entity (including \nforeign branches), wherever located, organized under the laws of Iran or \nany jurisdiction within Iran, or owned or controlled by the Government \nof Iran, or in Iran, or owned or controlled by any of the foregoing, that \nis engaged primarily in the business of banking (for example, banks, savings \nbanks, savings associations, credit unions, trust companies, and bank holding \ncompanies); \n(h) the term ‘‘Iranian person,’’ as used in sections 2 and 3 of this order, \nmeans an individual who is a citizen or national of Iran or an entity \norganized under the laws of Iran or otherwise subject to the jurisdiction \nof the Government of Iran; \n(i) the terms ‘‘knowledge’’ and ‘‘knowingly,’’ with respect to conduct, \na circumstance, or a result, mean that a person has actual knowledge, or \nshould have known, of the conduct, the circumstance, or the result; \n(j) the term ‘‘person’’ means an individual or entity; \n(k) the term ‘‘petroleum’’ (also known as crude oil) means a mixture \nof hydrocarbons that exists in liquid phase in natural underground reservoirs \nand remains liquid at atmospheric pressure after passing through surface \nseparating facilities; \n(l) the term ‘‘petroleum products’’ includes unfinished oils, liquefied petro-\nleum gases, pentanes plus, aviation gasoline, motor gasoline, naphtha-type \njet fuel, kerosene-type jet fuel, kerosene, distillate fuel oil, residual fuel \noil, petrochemical feedstocks, special naphthas, lubricants, waxes, petroleum \ncoke, asphalt, road oil, still gas, and miscellaneous products obtained from \nthe processing of: crude oil (including lease condensate), natural gas, and \nother hydrocarbon compounds."],"scope":"partial","signing_date":"2013-06-03","target_id":"EO:12957","verb":"transfer"}

- **ACT:EO:12957>EO:13645@01660e16cb1df778**; S5907db7c403eaa1d90991758; {"actor_id":"EO:13645","char_end":29273,"char_start":28642,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":1773,"char_start":1096,"text":"(a) The Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary \nof State, is hereby authorized to impose on a foreign financial institution \nthe sanctions described in subsection (b) of this section upon determining \nthat the foreign financial institution has, on or after the effective date of \nthis order: \n(i) knowingly conducted or facilitated any significant transaction related \nto the purchase or sale of Iranian rials or a derivative, swap, future, \nforward, or other similar contract whose value is based on the exchange \nrate of the Iranian rial; or \n(ii) maintained significant funds or accounts outside the territory of Iran \ndenominated in the Iranian rial."},{"char_end":2983,"char_start":2660,"text":"(c) The prohibitions in subsection (b) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":5315,"char_start":4992,"text":"(c) The prohibitions in subsection (b) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":6373,"char_start":5325,"text":"(a) The Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary \nof State, is hereby authorized to impose on a foreign financial institution \nthe sanctions described in subsection (b) of this section upon determining \nthat the foreign financial institution has knowingly conducted or facilitated \nany significant financial transaction: \n(i) on behalf of any Iranian person included on the SDN List (other \nthan an Iranian depository institution whose property and interests in \nproperty are blocked solely pursuant to Executive Order 13599) or any \nother person included on the SDN List whose property and interests \nin property are blocked pursuant to subsection 2(a)(i) of this order or \nExecutive Order 13599 (other than an Iranian depository institution whose \nproperty and interests in property are blocked solely pursuant to Executive \nOrder 13599); or \n(ii) on or after the effective date of this order, for the sale, supply, or \ntransfer to Iran of significant goods or services used in connection with \nthe automotive sector of Iran."},{"char_end":9058,"char_start":8735,"text":"(f) The prohibitions in subsection (b) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":10873,"char_start":9436,"text":"The Secretary of State, in consultation with the Secretary of the \nTreasury, the Secretary of Commerce, the Secretary of Homeland Security, \nand the United States Trade Representative, and with the President of the \nExport-Import Bank, the Chairman of the Board of Governors of the Federal \nReserve System, and other agencies and officials as appropriate, is hereby \nauthorized to impose on a person any of the sanctions described in section \n6 or 7 of this order upon determining that the person: \n(a) on or after the effective date of this order, knowingly engaged in \na significant transaction for the sale, supply, or transfer to Iran of significant \ngoods or services used in connection with the automotive sector of Iran; \n(b) is a successor entity to a person determined by the Secretary of State \nin accordance with this section to meet the criteria in subsection (a) of \nthis section; \n(c) owns or controls a person determined by the Secretary of State in \naccordance with this section to meet the criteria in subsection (a) of this \nsection, and had knowledge that the person engaged in the activities referred \nto in that subsection; or \n(d) is owned or controlled by, or under common ownership or control \nwith, a person determined by the Secretary of State in accordance with \nthis section to meet the criteria in subsection (a) of this section, and know-\ningly participated in the activities referred to in that subsection."},{"char_end":13888,"char_start":13560,"text":"(g) The prohibitions in subsections (a)–(f) of this section apply except \nto the extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, \nor licenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":17188,"char_start":16865,"text":"(b) The prohibitions in subsection (a) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":18994,"char_start":18671,"text":"(b) The prohibitions in subsection (a) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":29273,"char_start":29016,"text":"I therefore determine that for these measures to be effective in addressing \nthe national emergency declared in Executive Order 12957, there need be \nno prior notice of an action taken pursuant to subsection 1(b)(ii), 2(b), \n7(a)(iv), or 8(a) of this order."},{"char_end":30310,"char_start":29862,"text":"(c) Subsection (a)(i) of section 2 is amended by replacing ‘‘knowingly, \non or after the effective date of this order, engaged in a significant transaction \nfor the purchase or acquisition of petroleum or petroleum products from \nIran’’ with ‘‘knowingly, on or after the effective date of this order, engaged \nin a significant transaction for the purchase, acquisition, sale, transport, \nor marketing of petroleum or petroleum products from Iran’’."},{"char_end":30744,"char_start":30312,"text":"(d) Subsection (a)(ii) of section 2 is amended by replacing ‘‘knowingly, \non or after the effective date of this order, engaged in a significant transaction \nfor the purchase or acquisition of petrochemical products from Iran’’ with \n‘‘knowingly, on or after the effective date of this order, engaged in a signifi-\ncant transaction for the purchase, acquisition, sale, transport, or marketing \nof petrochemical products from Iran’’."},{"char_end":31963,"char_start":31886,"text":"This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on July \n1, 2013."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12957>EO:13645@01660e16cb1df778","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending asserted. Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date.","provision_label":"Sec. 14.","reaches_target_via":"","savings_phrases":["It includes but is not limited to depository institutions, \nbanks, savings banks, money service businesses, trust companies, securities \nbrokers and dealers, commodity futures and options brokers and dealers, \nforward contract and foreign exchange merchants, securities and commodities \nexchanges, clearing corporations, investment companies, employee benefit \nplans, dealers in precious metals, stones, or jewels, and holding companies, \naffiliates, or subsidiaries of any of the foregoing.","The term does not include \nthe international financial institutions identified in 22 U.S.C. 262r(c)(2), \nthe International Fund for Agricultural Development, the North American \nDevelopment Bank, or any other international financial institution so notified \nby the Secretary of the Treasury; \n(e) the term ‘‘Government of Iran’’ includes the Government of Iran, any \npolitical subdivision, agency, or instrumentality thereof, including the Central \nVerDate Mar<15>2010 19:51 Jun 04, 2013 Jkt 226001 PO 00000 Frm 00006 Fmt 4790 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\05JNE0.SGM 05JNE0mstockstill on DSK4VPTVN1PROD with PREDOCE0\n=== PDF page 7 of 9 ===\n33951 Federal Register / Vol. 78, No. 108 / Wednesday, June 5, 2013 / Presidential Documents \nBank of Iran, and any person owned or controlled by, or acting for or \non behalf of, the Government of Iran; \n(f) the term ‘‘Iran’’ means the Government of Iran and the territory of \nIran and any other territory or marine area, including the exclusive economic \nzone and continental shelf, over which the Government of Iran claims sov-\nereignty, sovereign rights, or jurisdiction, provided that the Government \nof Iran exercises partial or total de facto control over the area or derives \na benefit from economic activity in the area pursuant to international arrange-\nments; \n(g) the term ‘‘Iranian depository institution’’ means any entity (including \nforeign branches), wherever located, organized under the laws of Iran or \nany jurisdiction within Iran, or owned or controlled by the Government \nof Iran, or in Iran, or owned or controlled by any of the foregoing, that \nis engaged primarily in the business of banking (for example, banks, savings \nbanks, savings associations, credit unions, trust companies, and bank holding \ncompanies); \n(h) the term ‘‘Iranian person,’’ as used in sections 2 and 3 of this order, \nmeans an individual who is a citizen or national of Iran or an entity \norganized under the laws of Iran or otherwise subject to the jurisdiction \nof the Government of Iran; \n(i) the terms ‘‘knowledge’’ and ‘‘knowingly,’’ with respect to conduct, \na circumstance, or a result, mean that a person has actual knowledge, or \nshould have known, of the conduct, the circumstance, or the result; \n(j) the term ‘‘person’’ means an individual or entity; \n(k) the term ‘‘petroleum’’ (also known as crude oil) means a mixture \nof hydrocarbons that exists in liquid phase in natural underground reservoirs \nand remains liquid at atmospheric pressure after passing through surface \nseparating facilities; \n(l) the term ‘‘petroleum products’’ includes unfinished oils, liquefied petro-\nleum gases, pentanes plus, aviation gasoline, motor gasoline, naphtha-type \njet fuel, kerosene-type jet fuel, kerosene, distillate fuel oil, residual fuel \noil, petrochemical feedstocks, special naphthas, lubricants, waxes, petroleum \ncoke, asphalt, road oil, still gas, and miscellaneous products obtained from \nthe processing of: crude oil (including lease condensate), natural gas, and \nother hydrocarbon compounds."],"scope":"partial","signing_date":"2013-06-03","target_id":"EO:12957","verb":"transfer"}

{"actor_id":"EO:13645","char_end":29884,"char_start":29253,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":2384,"char_start":1707,"text":"(a) The Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary \nof State, is hereby authorized to impose on a foreign financial institution \nthe sanctions described in subsection (b) of this section upon determining \nthat the foreign financial institution has, on or after the effective date of \nthis order: \n(i) knowingly conducted or facilitated any significant transaction related \nto the purchase or sale of Iranian rials or a derivative, swap, future, \nforward, or other similar contract whose value is based on the exchange \nrate of the Iranian rial; or \n(ii) maintained significant funds or accounts outside the territory of Iran \ndenominated in the Iranian rial."},{"char_end":3594,"char_start":3271,"text":"(c) The prohibitions in subsection (b) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":5926,"char_start":5603,"text":"(c) The prohibitions in subsection (b) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":6984,"char_start":5936,"text":"(a) The Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary \nof State, is hereby authorized to impose on a foreign financial institution \nthe sanctions described in subsection (b) of this section upon determining \nthat the foreign financial institution has knowingly conducted or facilitated \nany significant financial transaction: \n(i) on behalf of any Iranian person included on the SDN List (other \nthan an Iranian depository institution whose property and interests in \nproperty are blocked solely pursuant to Executive Order 13599) or any \nother person included on the SDN List whose property and interests \nin property are blocked pursuant to subsection 2(a)(i) of this order or \nExecutive Order 13599 (other than an Iranian depository institution whose \nproperty and interests in property are blocked solely pursuant to Executive \nOrder 13599); or \n(ii) on or after the effective date of this order, for the sale, supply, or \ntransfer to Iran of significant goods or services used in connection with \nthe automotive sector of Iran."},{"char_end":9669,"char_start":9346,"text":"(f) The prohibitions in subsection (b) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":11484,"char_start":10047,"text":"The Secretary of State, in consultation with the Secretary of the \nTreasury, the Secretary of Commerce, the Secretary of Homeland Security, \nand the United States Trade Representative, and with the President of the \nExport-Import Bank, the Chairman of the Board of Governors of the Federal \nReserve System, and other agencies and officials as appropriate, is hereby \nauthorized to impose on a person any of the sanctions described in section \n6 or 7 of this order upon determining that the person: \n(a) on or after the effective date of this order, knowingly engaged in \na significant transaction for the sale, supply, or transfer to Iran of significant \ngoods or services used in connection with the automotive sector of Iran; \n(b) is a successor entity to a person determined by the Secretary of State \nin accordance with this section to meet the criteria in subsection (a) of \nthis section; \n(c) owns or controls a person determined by the Secretary of State in \naccordance with this section to meet the criteria in subsection (a) of this \nsection, and had knowledge that the person engaged in the activities referred \nto in that subsection; or \n(d) is owned or controlled by, or under common ownership or control \nwith, a person determined by the Secretary of State in accordance with \nthis section to meet the criteria in subsection (a) of this section, and know-\ningly participated in the activities referred to in that subsection."},{"char_end":14499,"char_start":14171,"text":"(g) The prohibitions in subsections (a)–(f) of this section apply except \nto the extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, \nor licenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":17799,"char_start":17476,"text":"(b) The prohibitions in subsection (a) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":19605,"char_start":19282,"text":"(b) The prohibitions in subsection (a) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":29884,"char_start":29627,"text":"I therefore determine that for these measures to be effective in addressing \nthe national emergency declared in Executive Order 12957, there need be \nno prior notice of an action taken pursuant to subsection 1(b)(ii), 2(b), \n7(a)(iv), or 8(a) of this order."},{"char_end":30921,"char_start":30473,"text":"(c) Subsection (a)(i) of section 2 is amended by replacing ‘‘knowingly, \non or after the effective date of this order, engaged in a significant transaction \nfor the purchase or acquisition of petroleum or petroleum products from \nIran’’ with ‘‘knowingly, on or after the effective date of this order, engaged \nin a significant transaction for the purchase, acquisition, sale, transport, \nor marketing of petroleum or petroleum products from Iran’’."},{"char_end":31355,"char_start":30923,"text":"(d) Subsection (a)(ii) of section 2 is amended by replacing ‘‘knowingly, \non or after the effective date of this order, engaged in a significant transaction \nfor the purchase or acquisition of petrochemical products from Iran’’ with \n‘‘knowingly, on or after the effective date of this order, engaged in a signifi-\ncant transaction for the purchase, acquisition, sale, transport, or marketing \nof petrochemical products from Iran’’."},{"char_end":32574,"char_start":32497,"text":"This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on July \n1, 2013."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12957>EO:13645@f393275ec4cb0d99","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending asserted. Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date.","provision_label":"Sec. 14.","reaches_target_via":"","savings_phrases":["It includes but is not limited to depository institutions, \nbanks, savings banks, money service businesses, trust companies, securities \nbrokers and dealers, commodity futures and options brokers and dealers, \nforward contract and foreign exchange merchants, securities and commodities \nexchanges, clearing corporations, investment companies, employee benefit \nplans, dealers in precious metals, stones, or jewels, and holding companies, \naffiliates, or subsidiaries of any of the foregoing.","The term does not include \nthe international financial institutions identified in 22 U.S.C. 262r(c)(2), \nthe International Fund for Agricultural Development, the North American \nDevelopment Bank, or any other international financial institution so notified \nby the Secretary of the Treasury; \n(e) the term ‘‘Government of Iran’’ includes the Government of Iran, any \npolitical subdivision, agency, or instrumentality thereof, including the Central \nVerDate Mar<15>2010 19:51 Jun 04, 2013 Jkt 226001 PO 00000 Frm 00006 Fmt 4790 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\05JNE0.SGM 05JNE0mstockstill on DSK4VPTVN1PROD with PREDOCE0\n=== PDF page 7 of 9 ===\n33951 Federal Register / Vol. 78, No. 108 / Wednesday, June 5, 2013 / Presidential Documents \nBank of Iran, and any person owned or controlled by, or acting for or \non behalf of, the Government of Iran; \n(f) the term ‘‘Iran’’ means the Government of Iran and the territory of \nIran and any other territory or marine area, including the exclusive economic \nzone and continental shelf, over which the Government of Iran claims sov-\nereignty, sovereign rights, or jurisdiction, provided that the Government \nof Iran exercises partial or total de facto control over the area or derives \na benefit from economic activity in the area pursuant to international arrange-\nments; \n(g) the term ‘‘Iranian depository institution’’ means any entity (including \nforeign branches), wherever located, organized under the laws of Iran or \nany jurisdiction within Iran, or owned or controlled by the Government \nof Iran, or in Iran, or owned or controlled by any of the foregoing, that \nis engaged primarily in the business of banking (for example, banks, savings \nbanks, savings associations, credit unions, trust companies, and bank holding \ncompanies); \n(h) the term ‘‘Iranian person,’’ as used in sections 2 and 3 of this order, \nmeans an individual who is a citizen or national of Iran or an entity \norganized under the laws of Iran or otherwise subject to the jurisdiction \nof the Government of Iran; \n(i) the terms ‘‘knowledge’’ and ‘‘knowingly,’’ with respect to conduct, \na circumstance, or a result, mean that a person has actual knowledge, or \nshould have known, of the conduct, the circumstance, or the result; \n(j) the term ‘‘person’’ means an individual or entity; \n(k) the term ‘‘petroleum’’ (also known as crude oil) means a mixture \nof hydrocarbons that exists in liquid phase in natural underground reservoirs \nand remains liquid at atmospheric pressure after passing through surface \nseparating facilities; \n(l) the term ‘‘petroleum products’’ includes unfinished oils, liquefied petro-\nleum gases, pentanes plus, aviation gasoline, motor gasoline, naphtha-type \njet fuel, kerosene-type jet fuel, kerosene, distillate fuel oil, residual fuel \noil, petrochemical feedstocks, special naphthas, lubricants, waxes, petroleum \ncoke, asphalt, road oil, still gas, and miscellaneous products obtained from \nthe processing of: crude oil (including lease condensate), natural gas, and \nother hydrocarbon compounds."],"scope":"partial","signing_date":"2013-06-03","target_id":"EO:12957","verb":"transfer"}

Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date.","provision_label":"Sec. 16.","reaches_target_via":"","savings_phrases":["It includes, but is not limited \nto, depository institutions, banks, savings banks, money service businesses, \ntrust companies, securities brokers and dealers, commodity futures and op-\ntions brokers and dealers, forward contract and foreign exchange merchants, \nsecurities and commodities exchanges, clearing corporations, investment \ncompanies, employee benefit plans, dealers in precious metals, stones, or \njewels, and holding companies, affiliates, or subsidiaries of any of the fore-\ngoing.","The term does not include the international financial institutions \nidentified in 22 U.S.C. 262r(c)(2), the International Fund for Agricultural \nDevelopment, the North American Development Bank, or any other inter-\nnational financial institution so notified by the Secretary of the Treasury; \n(e) the term ‘‘Government of Iran’’ includes the Government of Iran, any \npolitical subdivision, agency, or instrumentality thereof, including the Central \nBank of Iran, and any person owned or controlled by, or acting for or \non behalf of, the Government of Iran; \n(f) the term ‘‘Iran’’ means the Government of Iran and the territory of \nIran and any other territory or marine area, including the exclusive economic \nzone and continental shelf, over which the Government of Iran claims sov-\nereignty, sovereign rights, or jurisdiction, provided that the Government \nof Iran exercises partial or total de facto control over the area or derives \na benefit from economic activity in the area pursuant to international arrange-\nments; \n(g) the term ‘‘Iranian depository institution’’ means any entity (including \nforeign branches), wherever located, organized under the laws of Iran or \nany jurisdiction within Iran, or owned or controlled by the Government \nof Iran, or in Iran, or owned or controlled by any of the foregoing, that \nis engaged primarily in the business of banking (for example, banks, savings \nbanks, savings associations, credit unions, trust companies, and bank holding \ncompanies); \n(h) the term ‘‘Iranian person’’ means an individual who is a citizen or \nnational of Iran or an entity organized under the laws of Iran or otherwise \nsubject to the jurisdiction of the Government of Iran; \n(i) the terms ‘‘knowledge’’ and ‘‘knowingly,’’ with respect to conduct, \na circumstance, or a result, mean that a person has actual knowledge, or \nshould have known, of the conduct, the circumstance, or the result; \n(j) the terms ‘‘Naftiran Intertrade Company’’ and ‘‘NICO’’ mean the Naftiran \nIntertrade Company Ltd. and any entity owned or controlled by, or operating \nfor or on behalf of, the Naftiran Intertrade Company Ltd.; \n(k) the terms ‘‘National Iranian Oil Company’’ and ‘‘NIOC’’ mean the \nNational Iranian Oil Company and any entity owned or controlled by, or \noperating for or on behalf of, the National Iranian Oil Company; \n(l) the term ‘‘person’’ means an individual or entity; \nVerDate Sep<11>2014 17:48 Aug 06, 2018 Jkt 244001 PO 00000 Frm 00011 Fmt 4705 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\07AUE0.SGM 07AUE0daltland on DSKBBV9HB2PROD with PRES DOCS\n=== PDF page 10 of 11 ===\n38948 Federal Register / Vol. 83, No. 152 / Tuesday, August 7, 2018 / Presidential Documents \n(m) the term ‘‘petrochemical products’’ includes any aromatic, olefin, and \nsynthesis gas, and any of their derivatives, including ethylene, propylene, \nbutadiene, benzene, toluene, xylene, ammonia, methanol, and urea; \n(n) the term ‘‘petroleum’’ (also known as crude oil) means a mixture \nof hydrocarbons that exists in liquid phase in natural underground reservoirs \nand remains liquid at atmospheric pressure after passing through surface \nseparating facilities; \n(o) the term ‘‘petroleum products’’ includes unfinished oils, liquefied petro-\nleum gases, pentanes plus, aviation gasoline, motor gasoline, naphtha-type \njet fuel, kerosene-type jet fuel, kerosene, distillate fuel oil, residual fuel \noil, petrochemical feedstocks, special naphthas, lubricants, waxes, petroleum \ncoke, asphalt, road oil, still gas, and miscellaneous products obtained from \nthe processing of: crude oil (including lease condensate), natural gas, and \nother hydrocarbon compounds.","(a) Pursuant to section 202 of the NEA \n(50 U.S.C. 1622), the revocation of Executive Orders 13716 and 13628 as \nset forth in section 9 of this order, shall not affect any action taken or \nproceeding pending not finally concluded or determined as of the effective \ndate of this order, or any action or proceeding based on any act committed \nprior to the effective date of this order, or any rights or duties that matured \nor penalties that were incurred prior to the effective date of this order."],"scope":"whole","signing_date":"2018-08-06","target_id":"EO:12957","verb":"transfer"}

\n(j) the terms ‘‘Naftiran Intertrade Company’’ and ‘‘NICO’’ mean the Naftiran \nIntertrade Company Ltd. and any entity owned or controlled by, or operating \nfor or on behalf of, the Naftiran Intertrade Company Ltd.; \n(k) the terms ‘‘National Iranian Oil Company’’ and ‘‘NIOC’’ mean the \nNational Iranian Oil Company and any entity owned or controlled by, or \noperating for or on behalf of, the National Iranian Oil Company; \n(l) the term ‘‘person’’ means an individual or entity; \nVerDate Sep<11>2014 17:48 Aug 06, 2018 Jkt 244001 PO 00000 Frm 00011 Fmt 4705 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\07AUE0.SGM 07AUE0daltland on DSKBBV9HB2PROD with PRES DOCS\n=== PDF page 10 of 11 ===\n38948 Federal Register / Vol. 83, No. 152 / Tuesday, August 7, 2018 / Presidential Documents \n(m) the term ‘‘petrochemical products’’ includes any aromatic, olefin, and \nsynthesis gas, and any of their derivatives, including ethylene, propylene, \nbutadiene, benzene, toluene, xylene, ammonia, methanol, and urea; \n(n) the term ‘‘petroleum’’ (also known as crude oil) means a mixture \nof hydrocarbons that exists in liquid phase in natural underground reservoirs \nand remains liquid at atmospheric pressure after passing through surface \nseparating facilities; \n(o) the term ‘‘petroleum products’’ includes unfinished oils, liquefied petro-\nleum gases, pentanes plus, aviation gasoline, motor gasoline, naphtha-type \njet fuel, kerosene-type jet fuel, kerosene, distillate fuel oil, residual fuel \noil, petrochemical feedstocks, special naphthas, lubricants, waxes, petroleum \ncoke, asphalt, road oil, still gas, and miscellaneous products obtained from \nthe processing of: crude oil (including lease condensate), natural gas, and \nother hydrocarbon compounds.","(a) Pursuant to section 202 of the NEA \n(50 U.S.C. 1622), the revocation of Executive Orders 13716 and 13628 as \nset forth in section 9 of this order, shall not affect any action taken or \nproceeding pending not finally concluded or determined as of the effective \ndate of this order, or any action or proceeding based on any act committed \nprior to the effective date of this order, or any rights or duties that matured \nor penalties that were incurred prior to the effective date of this order."],"scope":"whole","signing_date":"2018-08-06","target_id":"EO:12957","verb":"transfer"}

Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date.","provision_label":"Sec. 16.","reaches_target_via":"","savings_phrases":["It includes, but is not limited \nto, depository institutions, banks, savings banks, money service businesses, \ntrust companies, securities brokers and dealers, commodity futures and op-\ntions brokers and dealers, forward contract and foreign exchange merchants, \nsecurities and commodities exchanges, clearing corporations, investment \ncompanies, employee benefit plans, dealers in precious metals, stones, or \njewels, and holding companies, affiliates, or subsidiaries of any of the fore-\ngoing.","The term does not include the international financial institutions \nidentified in 22 U.S.C. 262r(c)(2), the International Fund for Agricultural \nDevelopment, the North American Development Bank, or any other inter-\nnational financial institution so notified by the Secretary of the Treasury; \n(e) the term ‘‘Government of Iran’’ includes the Government of Iran, any \npolitical subdivision, agency, or instrumentality thereof, including the Central \nBank of Iran, and any person owned or controlled by, or acting for or \non behalf of, the Government of Iran; \n(f) the term ‘‘Iran’’ means the Government of Iran and the territory of \nIran and any other territory or marine area, including the exclusive economic \nzone and continental shelf, over which the Government of Iran claims sov-\nereignty, sovereign rights, or jurisdiction, provided that the Government \nof Iran exercises partial or total de facto control over the area or derives \na benefit from economic activity in the area pursuant to international arrange-\nments; \n(g) the term ‘‘Iranian depository institution’’ means any entity (including \nforeign branches), wherever located, organized under the laws of Iran or \nany jurisdiction within Iran, or owned or controlled by the Government \nof Iran, or in Iran, or owned or controlled by any of the foregoing, that \nis engaged primarily in the business of banking (for example, banks, savings \nbanks, savings associations, credit unions, trust companies, and bank holding \ncompanies); \n(h) the term ‘‘Iranian person’’ means an individual who is a citizen or \nnational of Iran or an entity organized under the laws of Iran or otherwise \nsubject to the jurisdiction of the Government of Iran; \n(i) the terms ‘‘knowledge’’ and ‘‘knowingly,’’ with respect to conduct, \na circumstance, or a result, mean that a person has actual knowledge, or \nshould have known, of the conduct, the circumstance, or the result; \n(j) the terms ‘‘Naftiran Intertrade Company’’ and ‘‘NICO’’ mean the Naftiran \nIntertrade Company Ltd. and any entity owned or controlled by, or operating \nfor or on behalf of, the Naftiran Intertrade Company Ltd.; \n(k) the terms ‘‘National Iranian Oil Company’’ and ‘‘NIOC’’ mean the \nNational Iranian Oil Company and any entity owned or controlled by, or \noperating for or on behalf of, the National Iranian Oil Company; \n(n) the term ‘‘petroleum’’ (also known as crude oil) means a mixture \nof hydrocarbons that exists in liquid phase in natural underground reservoirs \nand remains liquid at atmospheric pressure after passing through surface \nseparating facilities; \n(o) the term ‘‘petroleum products’’ includes unfinished oils, liquefied petro-\nleum gases, pentanes plus, aviation gasoline, motor gasoline, naphtha-type \njet fuel, kerosene-type jet fuel, kerosene, distillate fuel oil, residual fuel \noil, petrochemical feedstocks, special naphthas, lubricants, waxes, petroleum \ncoke, asphalt, road oil, still gas, and miscellaneous products obtained from \nthe processing of: crude oil (including lease condensate), natural gas, and \nother hydrocarbon compounds.","(a) Pursuant to section 202 of the NEA \n(50 U.S.C. 1622), the revocation of Executive Orders 13716 and 13628 as \nset forth in section 9 of this order, shall not affect any action taken or \nproceeding pending not finally concluded or determined as of the effective \ndate of this order, or any action or proceeding based on any act committed \nprior to the effective date of this order, or any rights or duties that matured \nor penalties that were incurred prior to the effective date of this order."],"scope":"whole","signing_date":"2018-08-06","target_id":"EO:12957","verb":"transfer"}

- **ACT:EO:12959>EO:13059@5f06e36f641cb6a7**; Safe7a38775139fbc34af60d5; {"actor_id":"EO:13059","char_end":8852,"char_start":8651,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":1482,"char_start":945,"text":"Except to the extent provided in section 3 of this order or\nin regulations, orders, directives, or licenses issued pursuant to this order,\nand notwithstanding any contract entered into or any license or permit\ngranted prior to the effective date of this order, the importation into the\nUnited States of any goods or services of Iranian origin or owned or controlled\nby the Government of Iran, other than information or informational materials\nwithin the meaning of section 203(b)(3) of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)(3)),\nis hereby prohibited."},{"char_end":5053,"char_start":1491,"text":"Except to the extent provided in section 3 of this order, in section\n203(b) of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)), or in regulations, orders, directives,\nor licenses issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding any contract\nentered into or any license or permit granted prior to the effective date\nof this order, the following are prohibited:\n(a) the exportation, reexportation, sale, or supply, directly or indirectly,\nfrom the United States, or by a United States person, wherever located,\nof any goods, technology, or services to Iran or the Government of Iran,\nincluding the exportation, reexportation, sale, or supply of any goods, tech-\nnology, or services to a person in a third country undertaken with knowledge\nor reason to know that:\n(i) such goods, technology, or services are intended specifically for supply,\ntransshipment, or reexportation, directly or indirectly, to Iran or the Govern-\nment of Iran; or\n(ii) such goods, technology, or services are intended specifically for use\nin the production of, for commingling with, or for incorporation into goods,\ntechnology, or services to be directly or indirectly supplied, transshipped,\nor reexported exclusively or predominantly to Iran or the Government of\nIran;\n(b) the reexportation from a third country, directly or indirectly, by a\nperson other than a United States person of any goods, technology, or\nservices that have been exported from the United States, if:\n(i) undertaken with knowledge or reason to know that the reexportation\nis intended specifically for Iran or the Government of Iran, and\n(ii) the exportation of such goods, technology, or services to Iran from\nthe United States was subject to export license application requirements\nunder any United States regulations in effect on May 6, 1995, or thereafter\nis made subject to such requirements imposed independently of the actions\ntaken pursuant to the national emergency declared in Executive Order 12957;\nprovided, however, that this prohibition shall not apply to those goods\nor that technology subject to export license application requirements if such\ngoods or technology have been:\n(A) substantially transformed into a foreign-made product outside the Unit-\ned States; or\n(B) incorporated into a foreign-made product outside the United States\nif the aggregate value of such controlled United States goods and technology\nconstitutes less than 10 percent of the total value of the foreign-made product\nto be exported from a third country;\n(c) any new investment by a United States person in Iran or in property,\nincluding entities, owned or controlled by the Government of Iran;\n(d) any transaction or dealing by a United States person, wherever located,\nincluding purchasing, selling, transporting, swapping, brokering, approving,\nfinancing, facilitating, or guaranteeing, in or related to:\n(i) goods or services of Iranian origin or owned or controlled by the\nGovernment of Iran; or\n(ii) goods, technology, or services for exportation, reexportation, sale, or\nsupply, directly or indirectly, to Iran or the Government of Iran;\n(e) any approval, financing, facilitation, or guarantee by a United States\nperson, wherever located, of a transaction by a foreign person where the\ntransaction by that foreign person would be prohibited by this order if\nperformed by a United States person or within the United States; and\n(f) any transaction by a United States person or within the United States\nthat evades or avoids, or has the purpose of evading or avoiding, or attempts\nto violate, any of the prohibitions set forth in this order."},{"char_end":5295,"char_start":5062,"text":"Specific licenses issued pursuant to Executive Orders 12613 (of\nOctober 29, 1987), 12957, or 12959 continue in effect in accordance with\ntheir terms except to the extent revoked, amended, or modified by the\nSecretary of the Treasury."},{"char_end":5562,"char_start":5296,"text":"General licenses, regulations, orders, and directives\nissued pursuant to those orders continue in effect in accordance with their\nterms except to the extent inconsistent with this order or to the extent\nrevoked, amended, or modified by the Secretary of the Treasury."},{"char_end":6958,"char_start":5571,"text":"For the purposes of this order:\n(a) the term ‘‘person’’ means an individual or entity;\n(b) the term ‘‘entity’’ means a partnership, association, trust, joint venture,\ncorporation, or other organization;\n(c) the term ‘‘United States person’’ means any United States citizen,\npermanent resident alien, entity organized under the laws of the United\nStates (including foreign branches), or any person in the United States;\n(d) the term ‘‘Iran’’ means the territory of Iran and any other territory\nor marine area, including the exclusive economic zone and continental\nshelf, over which the Government of Iran claims sovereignty, sovereign\nrights, or jurisdiction, provided that the Government of Iran exercises partial\nor total de facto control over the area or derives a benefit from economic\nactivity in the area pursuant to international arrangements;\n(e) the term ‘‘Government of Iran’’ includes the Government of Iran, any\npolitical subdivision, agency, or instrumentality thereof, and any person\nowned or controlled by, or acting for or on behalf of, the Government\nof Iran;\n(f) the term ‘‘new investment’’ means:\n(i) a commitment or contribution of funds or other assets; or\n(ii) a loan or other extension of credit, made after the effective date\nof Executive Order 12957 as to transactions prohibited by that order, or\notherwise made after the effective date of Executive Order 12959."},{"char_end":8852,"char_start":8651,"text":"Executive Order 12613 and subsections\n(a), (b), (c), (d), and (f) of section 1 of Executive Order 12959 are hereby\nrevoked with respect to transactions occurring after the effective date of\nthis order."},{"char_end":9188,"char_start":8853,"text":"The revocation of those provisions shall not alter their applicabil-\nity to any transaction or violation occurring before the effective date of\nthis order, nor shall it affect the applicability of any rule, regulation, order,\nlicense, or other form of administrative action previously taken pursuant\nto Executive Orders 12613 or 12959."},{"char_end":9743,"char_start":9660,"text":"(a) This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on\nAugust 20, 1997."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12959>EO:13059@5f06e36f641cb6a7","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending asserted. Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date.","provision_label":"Sec. 7.","reaches_target_via":"","savings_phrases":["Specific licenses issued pursuant to Executive Orders 12613 (of\nOctober 29, 1987), 12957, or 12959 continue in effect in accordance with\ntheir terms except to the extent revoked, amended, or modified by the\nSecretary of the Treasury.","General licenses, regulations, orders, and directives\nissued pursuant to those orders continue in effect in accordance with their\nterms except to the extent inconsistent with this order or to the extent\nrevoked, amended, or modified by the Secretary of the Treasury."],"scope":"partial","signing_date":"1997-08-19","target_id":"EO:12959","verb":"revoke"}

provided, however, that this prohibition shall not apply to those goods or that technology subject to export license application requirements if such goods or technology have been:"},{"char_end":5206,"char_start":4973,"text":"Specific licenses issued pursuant to Executive Orders 12613 (of October 29, 1987), 12957, or 12959 continue in effect in accordance with their terms except to the extent revoked, amended, or modified by the Secretary of the Treasury."},{"char_end":5473,"char_start":5207,"text":"General licenses, regulations, orders, and directives issued pursuant to those orders continue in effect in accordance with their terms except to the extent inconsistent with this order or to the extent revoked, amended, or modified by the Secretary of the Treasury."},{"char_end":6867,"char_start":6699,"text":"made after the effective date of Executive Order 12957 as to transactions prohibited by that order, or otherwise made after the effective date of Executive Order 12959."},{"char_end":8763,"char_start":8562,"text":"Executive Order 12613 and subsections (a), (b), (c), (d), and (f) of section 1 of Executive Order 12959 are hereby revoked with respect to transactions occurring after the effective date of this order."},{"char_end":9097,"char_start":8764,"text":"The revocation of those provisions shall not alter their applicability to any transaction or violation occurring before the effective date of this order, nor shall it affect the applicability of any rule, regulation, order, license, or other form of administrative action previously taken pursuant to Executive Orders 12613 or 12959."},{"char_end":9655,"char_start":9572,"text":"(a) This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on August 20, 1997."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12959>EO:13059@97ea1a90870c6e8b","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending asserted. Express effective-date candidate; agent must confirm it reaches this provision.","provision_label":"Sec. 7.","reaches_target_via":"","savings_phrases":["Specific licenses issued pursuant to Executive Orders 12613 (of October 29, 1987), 12957, or 12959 continue in effect in accordance with their terms except to the extent revoked, amended, or modified by the Secretary of the Treasury.","General licenses, regulations, orders, and directives issued pursuant to those orders continue in effect in accordance with their terms except to the extent inconsistent with this order or to the extent revoked, amended, or modified by the Secretary of the Treasury."],"scope":"partial","signing_date":"1997-08-19","target_id":"EO:12959","verb":"revoke"}

acquire, possess, develop, transport, transfer, or use such \nitems, by any person or foreign country of proliferation concern, the measures \nset forth in subsections (b), (c), and (d) of this section shall be imposed \non that foreign person to the extent determined by the Secretary of State, \nin consultation with the implementing agency and other relevant agencies."},{"char_end":7734,"char_start":7484,"text":"I therefore determine that for these measures to be effective in addressing \nthe national emergency declared in Executive Order 12938, as amended, \nthere need be no prior notice of a listing or determination made pursuant \nto section 1 of this order."},{"char_end":9479,"char_start":9397,"text":"(a) This order is effective at 12:01 - **ACT:EO:13111>EO:13218**; S23c61fe2029932805fcf5bbf; {"actor_id":"EO:13218","char_end":6827,"char_start":6540,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":8366,"char_start":6865,"text":"The Committee shall provide\nthe President, through the Secretary of Labor (who shall ensure the coordina-\ntion of the activities of the Committee with the activities undertaken pursuant\nto sections 1 and 2 of the Executive Order on the 21st Century Workforce\nInitiative), an independent assessment of:\n(1) progress made by the Federal Government in its use and integration\nof technology in adult training programs, particularly in addressing the\nproblems of adult illiteracy;\n(2) how Federal Government programs, initiatives, and policies can en-\ncourage or accelerate training technology to provide more accessible, more\ntimely, and more cost- effective training opportunities for all Americans;\n(3) mechanisms for the Federal Government to widely deploy and utilize\ntechnology-mediated instruction so all Americans may take advantage of\nopportunities provided by learning technology;\nVerDate 11<MAY>2000 15:47 Jun 21, 2001 Jkt 194001 PO 00000 Frm 00004 Fmt 4705 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\22JNE0.SGM pfrm04 PsN: 22JNE0\n=== PDF page 3 of 3 ===\n33629Federal Register / Vol. 66, No. 121 / Friday, June 22, 2001 / Presidential Documents\n(4) the appropriate Federal Government role in research and development\nfor learning technologies and their applications in order to develop high-\nquality training and education opportunities for all Americans; and\n(5) such other issues regarding emerging technologies in government\ntraining as specified by the Secretary of Labor.’’\n(b) Revocation of Executive Order 13174."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:13111>EO:13218","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending asserted. ## Valla review leads and component attestations

Review lead only. Every case needs separate applicability, earlier-ending, scope, independent-command, savings and independent whole-case review.
Preparation attestations never approve legal conclusions or replace whole-case review.
